Catalonia's Decret 96/2026 (DOGC 9689, 18.6.2026) art. 1.5 does NOT fix a non-EU price; it authorises each university's consell social to set it: «Els consells socials de les universitats públiques ... poden establir el preu dels crèdits en qualsevol nivell d'estudis per als i les estudiants estrangers no residents que no siguin nacionals d'estats membres de la Unió Europea ni dels estats en els quals sigui aplicable el règim comunitari, sense que el preu corresponent pugui excedir el 100% del seu cost». language_requirement: "Official English language certification – Level B2 or higher according to the CEFR" (verbatim from the programme's specific-requirements page). A certificate is required, not merely fluency.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — inferred but arithmetically solid: the UPC catalogue's EU figure of €1,162 is exactly 19,37 × 60, and 19,37 EUR/credit is the price Decret 96/2026 fixes for a non-habilitante master for curso 2026-2027. The page itself does not print a year, so this is an inference from the arithmetic, flagged as such.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit and quantified on UPC's own catalogue page, which publishes two separate figures: "EU residents: €1,162" and "Non-EU residents: €2,700" for the same 60-ECTS master. UPC's general master's fees page independently states non-EU/non-resident students pay "€45 per credit" against €17.69–€19.37 for EU students. entry_requirements: Bachelor's or Technical Engineering degree in Telecommunications or ICT Engineering, specialising in Telecommunications Systems, Telematics, Electronic Systems, Audiovisual Systems or Science & Technologies of Telecommunications — or an MSc in those fields — obtained at an institution in the EHEA. Flexibility provision, quoted from the page: "With complementary coursework, other engineering degrees from EHEA or Telecommunications/ICT engineering degrees from outside EHEA" may be considered; an Admission Committee reviews applications and may recommend additional coursework to address gaps. Plus certified English B2. Places: 20 (September intake), 10 (February intake).
accepts_engineering_background: CONDITIONALLY, AND THIS IS THE CATCH. The default requirement is a Telecommunications/ICT engineering degree FROM THE EHEA. A Tunisian Software Engineering degree is neither telecommunications-specific nor from the EHEA, so it falls into the flexibility clause, which admits "Telecommunications/ICT engineering degrees from outside EHEA" WITH complementary coursework. Whether a Software Engineering degree counts as an ICT engineering degree for this purpose is an Admission Committee judgement and is NOT stated. Recorded as EXPLICIT-CONDITIONAL, not a clean yes.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) at title level — the register publishes Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos = 0 for 4315535 (60 ECTS = 15 obligatorios + 33 optativos + 12 TFM). BUT at APPLICANT level the programme explicitly reserves the right to impose them: entry for a non-EHEA or non-telecom engineering degree is available only "with complementary coursework", decided case by case by the Admission Committee. "The document does not specify the exact number of complementary credits required, leaving this determination to the Admission Committee's case-by-case review." For this candidate that is a live, unquantified cost and duration risk. NEEDS A HUMAN TO ASK THE COORDINATOR.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND as advanced standing. What the pages DO say is the reverse-direction point: graduates need a prior 240-ECTS bachelor's plus this 60-ECTS master to reach the 300 ECTS that EHEA doctoral admission requires. The candidate already holds 300 ECTS, which is relevant to PhD access but is NOT presented anywhere as grounds for reducing this master. No reconocimiento de créditos rule for a longer prior degree could be found.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25. CONFLICT worth flagging between two UPC sources for 2026-27: the MASTEAM programme page states 'Pre-enrolment is currently closed', while an UPC school (EPSEB) news page advertises a 2026-2027 preinscripción window of 18 February 2026 to 1 February 2027 covering both the autumn (September) and spring (February) entry semesters. Career outcomes name the audiovisual sector among ICT-driven industries. Rank this as a telecommunications-management master, not an audio-DSP one.

industry_links: Career outcomes named: network operations, telecommunications services, smart cities, data centres, and ICT-driven sectors "automotive, audiovisual, food, logistics, energy, finance, etc." No named partner companies found.

entry_requirements: Two admission tiers are published. PREFERRED backgrounds, admitted with NO bridging courses: ICT Systems Engineering, Informatics Engineering, Data Science and Engineering, Telecommunications Systems Engineering, Network Engineering. ALTERNATIVE backgrounds, admitted with UP TO 18 ECTS of bridging courses: Industrial Electronics and Automatic Control Engineering, Industrial Technology Engineering, Electrical Engineering. accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT, and favourably — "Informatics Engineering" and "ICT Systems Engineering" head the PREFERRED list, which is admitted with no bridging courses at all. A Software Engineering degree maps naturally onto Informatics Engineering; the residual risk is only that a Tunisian degree title may not be read as an exact match, in which case the master's committee evaluates it. This is the cleanest engineering fit in the batch.
complementary_credits_required: THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL FIELD ON THIS RECORD, and the two levels disagree in the way the brief warns about. credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND — no advanced-standing or reconocimiento de créditos provision for a 300-ECTS prior degree. institution: Universidad Autónoma de Madrid (UAM) — Escuela Politécnica Superior
modality: presencial ("In-person teaching")
language_of_instruction: "Inglés" (English) — stated as the idioma de impartición on UAM's own programme page, alongside a requirement for "knowledge of the English language at the minimum level of the B2 certificate". The Spanish-language field value «Inglés» is what settles it, not the fact that an English version of the page exists.
language_requirement: English at minimum CEFR B2, certificate required.
tuition_year_of_rates: As displayed on the UAM programme page on 2026-08-25. The page prints the two figures without an academic year; UAM's tasas-y-precios page is headed 2025-2026 and cites Decreto 43/2022 (BOCM 01/07/2022) as the standing legal basis. Treat as current-as-displayed and re-check for 2027-28. FLAGGED.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit, quantified, and published on the programme page itself: "Standard enrollment: €2,736" versus "Non-EU residents: €5,079" for the same 60-ECTS master, i.e. a surcharge of €2,343 (1.86x). Mechanism, from UAM's own tasas page: students from non-EU countries without official residency in Spain pay at the "tercera matrícula" (third-enrolment) rate, or the "cuarta" rate for másteres habilitantes, as established in the Comunidad de Madrid public-prices decree (Decreto 43/2022, BOCM 01/07/2022). This is a repricing to a penalty tier, not a flat uplift. Note it is charged on non-RESIDENCE, so the candidate cannot avoid it by relocating.
entry_requirements: An engineering degree or a bachelor's in ICT-related fields, with a MINIMUM PRIOR COURSEWORK PROFILE: 24 ECTS in mathematics (calculus, linear algebra, probability/statistics), 12 ECTS programming, 6 ECTS signal processing, and 6 ECTS machine learning. Admitted backgrounds: engineering degrees in ICT areas; equivalent EHEA degrees; degrees from outside Europe with equivalency demonstrated. 30 places. Admission application costs 27,54 EUR. Applicants with a non-Spanish access degree must supply the Ministry's «certificación de equivalencia de nota media para estudios en el extranjero».
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT — "engineering degrees in ICT areas" and non-European degrees with demonstrated equivalency are both named. THE REAL GATE IS THE SUBJECT PROFILE, NOT THE DEGREE TITLE: the candidate must be able to show 24 ECTS maths + 12 programming + 6 signal processing + 6 machine learning in his transcript. A 300-ECTS 5-year Software Engineering degree will almost certainly clear maths and programming; the 6 ECTS of SIGNAL PROCESSING and 6 of MACHINE LEARNING are the lines to check against his actual transcript before applying.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) at title level — the register publishes Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos = 0 for 4317140 (60 ECTS = 48 obligatorios + 12 TFM, 0 optativos, 0 prácticas). At APPLICANT level the programme offers an OPTIONAL levelling module in signal processing worth 1 ECTS for students whose prior training in that area falls below 12 ECTS — small, optional, and cheap. Separately, UAM's institution-wide rules state that the Comisión Académica of each master «determinará si debe cursar complementos de formación» at admission, so a formal power to impose them exists university-wide; for this title the published expectation is the 1-ECTS levelling module only.
credit_recognition_available: YES — A REAL, INSTITUTION-WIDE MECHANISM, and the best-documented one in this batch. UAM's official 2026-27 admission process document states that the Comisión Académica «determinará si debe cursar complementos de formación y si existe posibilidad de solicitar reconocimiento de créditos por los estudios previos realizados», and that «Se podrá señalar el número de créditos de los que el estudiante pueda solicitar reconocimiento (si tiene formación previa reconocible). Posteriormente a su matrícula el estudiante solicitará formalmente el reconocimiento en la Administración del Centro ... pero esta indicación le servirá para saber de cuántos créditos debe matricularse y cuantos no serán necesarios, porque puedan reconocerse.» So recognition is assessed AT ADMISSION and reduces the credits actually enrolled and paid for. IMPORTANT COUNTERWEIGHT from the same document: «La titulación de acceso al Máster que se considerará es siempre la de grado o equivalente. Cualquier otra titulación académica que posea el solicitante podrá incorporarse a la solicitud de forma complementaria y, en su caso, ser valorada por la coordinación del Máster como otros méritos» — extra qualifications count as merit, not as automatic advanced standing. programme_name_en: Master in Business Analytics
modality: presencial u online
language_of_instruction: "Español" — the programme page states the master «se imparte ... en idioma español». Despite the English title string «Master in Business Analytics», delivery is Spanish. This is exactly the trap the brief warns about.
language_requirement: «deberán acreditar un nivel B2 de Español» for students from non-Spanish-speaking countries; English: «Título Oficial de inglés (B2-First Certificate) o, en su defecto, prueba para acreditar al conocimiento del idioma».
non_eu_surcharge: YES — +20%, and it is easy to miss because Mondragon never uses the word 'extracomunitario'. The main mondragon.edu price page footnotes BOTH modality figures with: '** Precios para estudiantes de la Unión Europea. Será ratificado por el Consejo Rector.' — i.e. the headline 10.290 / 6.960 € are EU-only prices, so a non-EU applicant must NOT quote them. Mondragon publishes the non-EU figure only on its international portal latam.mondragon.edu, where the same master for the same 2026-27 year is 12.348 € presencial / 8.352 € online — a clean +20% on each. CAVEAT recorded rather than smoothed over: latam.mondragon.edu is branded as Mondragon's Latin America portal, so while it is the university's own domain and the only place it publishes a non-EU price, a Tunisian applicant should confirm in writing that the same +20% tariff (and not a third one) applies to them. Mondragon is private, so no autonomous-community decreto governs any of this.
entry_requirements: «Para acceder será necesario estar en posesión de un título universitario oficial español u otro expedido por una institución de educación superior del Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior que faculte para el acceso a enseñanzas de Máster.» Preferred profile: «titulados universitarios en Administración y Dirección de Empresas, Liderazgo Emprendedor e Innovación, Gestión de Negocios, Económica, Gestión y Marketing Empresarial, Marketing, Sociología, Analítica de Datos Aplicada a los Negocios, Finanzas y Seguros». For other candidates «se requieren conocimientos básicos previos en gestión empresarial y estadística y matemáticas». Admission weighting: expediente 30%, CV 20%, English certificate 10%, written test 20%, interview 20%. 60 plazas (per RUCT/page context).
accepts_engineering_background: IMPLICIT ONLY — engineering is not on the preferred list; a Software Engineering applicant falls under «otros candidatos» and must show prior basic knowledge of business management, statistics and mathematics. Not an explicit yes.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT). The requisitos de acceso page does NOT mention complementos de formación at applicant level — it instead imposes a prior-knowledge expectation in business management and statistics. Quoting the programme's own access page.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND
application_window_2027: 2027-28 DATES NOT YET PUBLISHED. Recording the 2026-27 calendar with its year marked: INSCRIPCIÓN 03/11/2025 – 03/07/2026, and 'Y si aún quedan plazas libres...' a second window 15/07/2026 – 11/09/2026. MATRICULACIÓN 10/07/2026 – 15/07/2026, and if places remain 18/07/2026 – 15/09/2026. language_requirement: English B2 (CEFR) or equivalent required for admission; Spanish B2 required for international students from non-Spanish-speaking countries.
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — the precios page quotes «182€» per ECTS explicitly for EU students and publishes no separate non-EU rate. Silence is not a 'no': a non-EU applicant must confirm their rate with the university.
entry_requirements: «Dirigido a alumnado en posesión de Títulos universitarios oficiales del ámbito de la Informática (sin complementos), Telemática, Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica y otros.» The acceso y admisión page details eight required competencies (web architecture, software development, databases, infrastructure, Linux administration, networking, statistics, cybersecurity): «Graduados/as en Ingenierías del ámbito de la Informática» holding all eight enter with no additional coursework. Candidates missing competencies take subjects from five formación complementaria options (Web Engineering, Infrastructure and Systems, Statistical Methods, Security, Databases; 4,5–6 ECTS each), offered January–July, all completed before the academic year begins: «La formación complementaria se ha diseñado para que el alumno o la alumna la curse con un alto nivel de autonomía». accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT AND UNUSUALLY DIRECT — the page names «Títulos universitarios oficiales del ámbito de la Informática (sin complementos)». A Software Engineering graduate is admitted WITHOUT bridging credits, provided the eight listed competencies are covered.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos = null for 4316970). At APPLICANT level the programme's own acceso y admisión page is explicit: computing graduates enter «sin complementos»; only candidates missing named competencies take 4,5–6 ECTS bridging subjects. Quoting the programme's admission page, not the register.
credit_recognition_available: No advanced-standing or reconocimiento-de-créditos rule is published for a 300-ECTS entrant. What IS published is the stronger practical answer for this candidate: exemption from complementos entirely for computing graduates.
application_window_2027: NOT FOUND for the Sept-2027 intake. modality: presencial
language_of_instruction: «Español» - the Universidad de Sevilla programme page gives Spanish as the language of instruction, and separately requires Spanish «nivel equivalente o superior al B2». No English-taught option. HARD BLOCKER at A0/A1.
language_requirement: Spanish at «nivel equivalente o superior al B2» stated on the programme page. No English certificate requirement found.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 rates, still in force (Decreto 98/2023 Anexo I as modified by Decreto 142/2025); no 2026-27 decree published as of 2026-08-25
non_eu_surcharge: no - Universidad de Sevilla states explicitly: «Como estudiante internacional, abonarás los mismos precios públicos que cualquier otra persona estudiante en la Universidad. El sistema de precios es igualitario y regulado por decreto autonómico, sin distinción por nacionalidad» (cat.us.es). NOTE the legal head-room: Decreto 98/2023 art. 3.2 says «El estudiantado extranjero ... que no sea residente en España abonará los precios ... No obstante, las universidades en que se matricule podrán establecer una variación en el precio de los créditos en cualquier nivel de estudios, sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del 100% del coste del servicio académico» - so a surcharge is authorised in Andalucía but US has not applied one and publishes the opposite.
entry_requirements: Preference bands published by the programme: HIGH - Grado en Ingeniería Informática, Grado en Ingeniería de la Salud, and the pre-Bologna Ingeniería en Informática / Ingeniería Técnica en Informática. MEDIUM - other engineering specialities (Industrial, Telecomunicación) or Administración y Dirección de Empresas. LOW - Matemáticas or Física, who must additionally prove software-development competence. Spanish B2 or above. 35 plazas. Classes Monday-Thursday 18:00-21:00, and the master may be spread over two years.
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT and in the highest preference band - Grado en Ingeniería Informática heads the list. A Software Engineering degree is the intended profile.
complementary_credits_required: RUCT (for the TITLE): NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — the Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos row is absent (null) for 4316602. Programme admission page (for the APPLICANT): complementos of up to 18 ECTS may be required of applicants whose prior degree is not in the preferred group; the Distrito Único Andaluz ficha ranks access degrees by preferencia Alta/Media/Baja. A software engineering degree falls in the computing family this master is built on, so on the published rule complementos would not be expected — but the US pages do not state that in terms, so this is recorded as "up to 18 ECTS possible, decided at admission", not as zero.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND - no statement on the programme page about reconocimiento de créditos or advanced standing for a 300-ECTS degree. The only related flexibility published is the option to spread the 60 ECTS over two years, which is the opposite of shortening.
application_window_2027: 2026-27 calendar (published; 2027-28 NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25). Fase 1, reserved for holders of a non-homologated foreign degree - THIS CANDIDATE'S ROUTE: solicitudes 13-29 January 2026. Fase 2: 17-26 June 2026. Fase 3: 8-15 September 2026. Dates are NOT shifted forward a year; the 2027-28 calendar is not out.
application_rounds: 2026-27 Fase 1 (exclusively for holders of a non-homologated foreign university degree): solicitudes 13-29/01/2026; 1a adjudicación 19/02; 2a 12/03; 3a 09/04 | 2026-27 Fase 2: solicitudes 17-26/06/2026 | 2026-27 Fase 3: solicitudes 08-15/09/2026

admissions_contact_email: accesomaster@us.es (Universidad de Sevilla máster admissions; a programme-specific address was NOT FOUND. Coordinator: Inmaculada Concepción Hernández Salmerón)

Three especialidades: (1) Ingeniería Web - scalable cloud-based applications; (2) Ingeniería de Datos - Big Data, AI, pattern discovery; (3) Gestión de las Tecnologías de la Información - IT management and project direction. The Cloud track is the AC fit, the Datos track the AB fit. Evening timetable (18:00-21:00) at the Escuela Internacional de Posgrado.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Coordinator Inmaculada Concepción Hernández Salmerón; ETSII / Dpto. Lenguajes y Sistemas Informáticos. Programme microsite www.master.us.es/ingsof.
industry_links: NOT FOUND as named partners; RUCT records 0 ECTS of prácticas, and the evening timetable is aimed at working professionals.

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Ciencia de Datos
programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Data Science
modality: presencial
language_of_instruction: «Lengua de docencia: Castellano» - the UV official data sheet gives Castellano as the single language of delivery. The English version of the site is a translation, not evidence of English teaching (rule 7). HARD BLOCKER at A0/A1.
language_requirement: «Para estudiantes de países de habla no hispana se requiere Acreditación B2 de español (a través de un Diploma de Español como Lengua Extranjera en un nivel de B2, o en su caso, prueba oral y escrita)». A DELE B2 in Spanish is therefore a formal admission requirement for this candidate. English at B1+ counts only as a minor admission merit (5% band).
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27. Anexo I item 2.2 of Decreto 101/2024 (DOGV 9913, 12/08/2024) sets «Estudios de máster no comprendidos en el grupo anterior» at 35,34 EUR/crédito, 1a matrícula; Decreto 122/2026, de 4 de agosto, del Consell modifies Decreto 101/2024 and keeps the enrolment prices frozen for curso 2026-2027. The UV programme sheet shows the same 35,34 / 70,68 pair.
non_eu_surcharge: YES - EXPLICIT AND DOUBLE. The UV official data sheet publishes two credit prices side by side: «Precio del crédito primera matrícula: 35.34€» and «Estudiantes extranjeros no UE: 70.68€». Legal base: Decreto 101/2024, de 2 de agosto, del Consell, art. 6.1 - «Al estudiantado extranjero, que no tenga la condición de residente, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea ..., se le aplicará el doble de los precios públicos establecidos en el anexo I ..., sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del cien por cien (100%) del coste del servicio académico». Art. 6.3 closes the escape route: «la autorización de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros de acuerdo con el Real decreto 557/2011 ... no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes» - a Spanish study visa does NOT make this candidate a resident. The 1.5x transitional rate in Disposición transitoria primera applied only to curso 2024-2025, so the full doubling applies now.
entry_requirements: «Se requiere formación previa de nivel grado o superior en áreas como: Matemáticas, Física, Ingenierías (Informática, Electrónica, Telecomunicación e Industriales), Economía, y Administración y Dirección de Empresas.» Candidates must show competence in mathematics and statistics, prior use of programming tools (R, C, Matlab, Python or similar) and knowledge of programming fundamentals and databases. 25 plazas. Admission is scored: adecuación al perfil de ingreso 50%, expediente académico 40%, experiencia profesional en análisis de datos 5%, otros méritos (titulaciones adicionales, idiomas B1+, seminarios) 5%. Spanish B2 accreditation required for applicants from non-Spanish-speaking countries.
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT - «Ingenierías (Informática, ...)» is named in the recommended entry profile, and it is the 50%-weighted admission criterion.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) at title level - the register records ects_complementos_formativos = 0. AT APPLICANT LEVEL the programme states: «Aquellos cuya formación previa sea insuficiente en los conocimientos requeridos deberán cursar complementos formativos establecidos en la memoria del programa» (section 4.6 of the memoria), judged by the Comisión Académica on mathematics/statistics/programming competence. So RUCT's 0 does NOT guarantee an applicant is exempt - this is one of the cases the brief warns about. A Software Engineering graduate would normally clear the programming test; the maths/statistics component is the one to evidence.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND - no statement of advanced standing or reconocimiento de créditos for a 300-ECTS first degree on the programme, data-sheet or admission pages. The 300 ECTS is useful here only as surplus over the entry bar; the master remains 90 ECTS over two courses.
application_window_2027: 2026-27 calendar (published; 2027-28 NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25). Fase 1: 30 March - 21 April 2026, 23:59. Fase 2: 25 May - 16 June 2026, 14:00. Fase Extraordinaria: 22-31 July and 24 August - 2 September 2026, 23:59. Dates are NOT shifted forward a year - the September 2027 intake calendar is not out.
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES, urgently. A holder of a degree from outside the EHEA that is not homologated must pay a 155,22 EUR «estudio de equivalencia» fee and, critically, «Obtaining the equivalence resolution is a requirement for the evaluation of the pre-enrolment application» - the application is not even assessed until the equivalence resolution is issued. A Tunisian degree holder must therefore enter in Fase 1 (the March-April window) to leave time for that resolution.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND - UV routes pre-enrolment queries through its «Support and Enquiries» web form rather than publishing an address. Programme director: Emilio Soria Olivas (ETSE-UV).
curriculum_summary: 90 ECTS over two academic years. RUCT breakdown: 65 obligatorios, 0 optativos, 10 prácticas externas, 15 TFM. Taught at the Escuela Técnica Superior de Ingeniería (ETSE-UV), Avenida de la Universitat s/n, 46100 Burjassot. The 10-ECTS compulsory external placement is unusual among Spanish data-science masters and is a real industry hook.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Director Emilio Soria Olivas (ETSE-UV; machine-learning / intelligent data analysis group IDAL). Escola Tècnica Superior d'Enginyeria.
industry_links: 10 ECTS of compulsory prácticas externas built into the title (RUCT), i.e. a mandatory company placement. Specific partner companies NOT FOUND on the pages read.
thesis_or_internship: Both: 10 ECTS prácticas externas + 15 ECTS Trabajo Fin de Máster.

language_requirement: NOT FOUND - no certificate level (Spanish or English) is published on the programme pages.

THIS IS THE ONLY FULLY ENGLISH-TAUGHT OFFICIAL MASTER IN THIS BATCH and it removes the batch's dominant blocker.
language_requirement: «Los solicitantes deben tener un buen dominio del inglés, ya que el programa se imparte íntegramente en este idioma». NO certificate level (B2/C1) or accepted test is specified anywhere on the pages read - that precise level is NOT FOUND and should be asked of the coordinator. Note that UA's generic non-Spanish-speaker Spanish-B2 rule is attached to its Spanish-taught masters (it is stated verbatim on the Ciencia de Datos access page); it is NOT stated on this programme's access page, which asks for English instead. A human should confirm no Spanish requirement is applied on top.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27. The UA course sheet for this master publishes «35,34€ (primera matrícula); 56,51 € (segunda y sucesivas matrículas)» alongside the 2026-27 preinscripción window. Legal base Decreto 101/2024 (DOGV 9913, 12/08/2024) Anexo I item 2.2, frozen for curso 2026-2027 by Decreto 122/2026, de 4 de agosto, del Consell.
non_eu_surcharge: YES - EXPLICIT AND DOUBLE. Universidad de Alicante states: «Al estudiantado extranjero, que no tenga la condición de residente, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea... se les aplicará el doble de los precios públicos establecidos», in force since curso 2024/2025, and UA notes that a student residence authorisation does not confer resident status. Legal base: Decreto 101/2024, de 2 de agosto, del Consell, art. 6.1 (double, capped at 100% of cost) and art. 6.3 (a RD 557/2011 study-stay authorisation «no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes»). 35,34 -> 70,68 EUR/crédito for this candidate.
entry_requirements: «Este programa está dirigido a estudiantes con una sólida formación cuantitativa, particularmente aquellos con títulos en Economía, Matemáticas, Física, Ingeniería u otras disciplinas con un fuerte enfoque cuantitativo», with Business Administration graduates holding strong quantitative competence also invited. Admission weightings: calificaciones en estudios previos, especialmente asignaturas relacionadas 60%; cartas de referencia 30%; otros méritos (cursos de formación o trabajos de investigación relacionados) 10%.
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT - «Ingeniería» is named in the target profile as a strongly quantitative discipline. city: Murcia (Facultad de Informática) — joint title also taught at USC, Santiago de Compostela
modality: presencial
language_of_instruction: "Idioma: Español" — verbatim from the UM programme page header (Centro: Facultad de Informática / Tipo de enseñanza: Presencial / Idioma: Español / Duración: 40 semanas / Créditos ECTS: 60 / Plazas de nuevo ingreso: 12 / Interuniversitario: Universidad de Murcia (UMU) y Universidad de Santiago de Compostela (USC)). SPANISH-ONLY. No English strand is offered.
language_requirement: No language certificate requirement published. Competence T4 is only "Conocimiento de otras lenguas, sobre todo la inglesa" as a learning outcome, not an entry condition. Spanish is required in practice.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2023-24 rates (Decreto n.º 8/2024, de 1 de febrero, BORM 10/02/2024) — this is the price order UM's own matrícula page still links as at 2026-08-25; no newer decree is published there. Rates for 2026-27 / 2027-28 are NOT PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — CONFIRMED AND PINNED (this field previously read NOT FOUND and has been CORRECTED against source). Universidad de Murcia's own 'Precios públicos' rules page states verbatim: "Las y los estudiantes extranjeros no comunitarios no residentes y estudiantes visitantes que se matriculen por primera vez en la Universidad de Murcia deberán abonar los derechos de secretaría que correspondan, además de los precios por la prestación de servicios académicos universitarios calculados según lo indicado en el artículo 21, incrementados en un 20%." The uplift applies whether it is a first, second or subsequent enrolment. So UM DOES exercise the power the regional decree grants it — Decreto n.º 8/2024 (Región de Murcia) art. 6.5: "Las universidades podrán diferenciar el precio del crédito hasta cubrir el 100 por 100 de los costes de las enseñanzas universitarias de grado y máster cuando se trate de estudiantes extranjeros mayores de dieciocho años que no tengan la condición de residentes, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea y aquéllos a quienes sea de aplicación el régimen comunitario, sin perjuicio del principio de reciprocidad" — but it exercises it at +20 per cent, far below the 100-per-cent-of-cost ceiling that decree permits. THIS CANDIDATE IS CAUGHT BY IT: a Tunisian national with no prior Spanish residency is 'extranjero no comunitario no residente'. OLDER, DIFFERENT RULE STILL PUBLISHED ON THE SAME SITE (logged, not silently reconciled): a UM Consejo de Gobierno document of 28/09/2012 states that from curso 2013-2014 non-EU non-resident students "les serán de aplicación las tarifas fijadas para los estudiantes visitantes" (visiting-student tariffs) rather than a percentage uplift. The current rules page governs; the 2012 document is retained because it is still live on um.es and a human should ask postgrado@um.es which tariff is actually billed.
entry_requirements: Access: Spanish/EHEA degree giving access to master's, OR a non-EHEA degree without homologación provided the university first verifies an equivalent level of training (UM's Comprobación del nivel de formación equivalente procedure, to be requested BEFORE the admission process). Entry profile, verbatim: "El máster está destinado principalmente a graduados en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Física, Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones y otras Ingenierías. También está enfocado a profesionales de empresa." Access degrees listed: Informática, Física, Matemáticas, Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica, Industriales, otras áreas de ciencias — "sin que exista prelación entre ellas". Programming prerequisite, verbatim: "Aunque no se asumen conocimientos previos en Tecnologías de Gestión y Análisis de Datos Masivos, se requiere que los solicitantes tengan competencias en programación básica y, en particular, en algún lenguaje programación (por ejemplo, C, Java, Fortran, Python o Matlab)." Only 12 new-entry places. Admission under the Reglamento de Postgrado Oficial de la UMU, decided by the Comisión Académica, prioritised on academic record.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT and emphatic. Ingeniería Informática is the first named target degree and the programming prerequisite is exactly this candidate's strength.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT — 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' = 0 for 4315427). No applicant-level complementos are imposed on a computing/engineering entrant; the only prerequisite stated is basic programming competence, which is satisfied.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND at programme level. UM runs a general 'Reconocimiento de créditos' service (https://www.um.es/web/estudios/utilidades/reconocimiento-creditos) and the price decree charges 25% of fees for recognised/convalidated credits, but no advanced-standing rule for a 300-ECTS 5-year foreign degree is published. NOTE the plan has no optional credits at all (42 obligatorias + 18 TFM), which leaves little room for recognition in practice.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. UM's published 2026-2027 master admission calendar (verbatim headings): Fase I - presentación de solicitudes 'Del 10 de marzo al 22 de abril'; Fase II 'Del 1 al 30 de junio'; Fase Extraordinaria 'Del 30 de julio al 3 de septiembre'. Provisional lists 30 April / 13 July / 8 September; definitive lists 12 May / 17 July / 11 September; matrícula 12-14 May / 17-20 July / 11-14 September.
application_rounds: 2026-27 Fase I: 10 March - 22 April 2026 | 2026-27 Fase II: 1 - 30 June 2026 | 2026-27 Fase Extraordinaria: 30 July - 3 September 2026
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — REQUIRED IN EFFECT. A holder of a non-homologated foreign degree must request the 'Comprobación del nivel de formación equivalente de estudios universitarios extranjeros ajenos al EEES' BEFORE the admission process ("deberán solicitar, con antelación al proceso de admisión"), resolved by the Comisiones de Ramas de Conocimiento. With only 12 places, Fase I (March-April) is the realistic target.
admissions_contact_email: postgrado@um.es (Sección de Postgrado, Edf. Rector Soler 3ª planta, Campus de Espinardo, 30100 Murcia); cau@um.es for portal issues
curriculum_summary: Verbatim from the plan de estudios page: "El plan de estudios consta de 9 materias y un Trabajo Fin de Máster (TFM). No se contemplan materias optativas ni prácticas en empresas. Esto da lugar a una oferta académica de 60 ECTS (18 ECTS del TFM y 42 ECTS de las materias obligatorias)." Four modules: Big Data, Ciencia de Datos, Aplicaciones de Negocio, Trabajo Fin de Máster. Specific competences cover distributed/large-scale computation, cloud execution of big-data applications, text and web mining, classification and search over massive unstructured repositories, regression/classification modelling, visualisation, IoT sensor-network data analytics, and choice of database/data paradigm on efficiency, scalability and fault-tolerance criteria. "El Máster tiene una orientación eminentemente investigadora."
notable_faculty_or_lab: Facultad de Informática, Universidad de Murcia, jointly with Universidad de Santiago de Compostela (CiTIUS environment on the USC side). NOT FOUND: named individual faculty on the pages read.
industry_links: NONE built into the plan — "No se contemplan materias optativas ni prácticas en empresas". Research-oriented; business-application module is taught, not placement-based.
thesis_or_internship: TFM 18 ECTS (RUCT: 42 obligatorios + 18 TFM, 0 prácticas). No internship.

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Robótica, Gráficos y Visión por Computador
programme_name_en: Master in Robotics, Graphics and Computer Vision (RGCV)
institution: Universidad de Zaragoza — Escuela de Ingeniería y Arquitectura (EINA)
modality: presencial
language_of_instruction: ENGLISH. Verbatim from the official Unizar programme page: "El objetivo del máster es proporcionar una formación de investigación, innovación y desarrollo en los ámbitos de Robótica, Gráficos y Visión por Computador. La lengua de impartición es el inglés." Corroborated by the plan de estudios, whose subject titles are all in English, and by the TFM rule: "El resultado se plasma en una memoria en forma de artículo o informe, escrito en inglés".
language_requirement: B2 English or higher, verbatim: "Para todos los títulos deberá acreditarse al menos nivel B2 de Inglés o equivalente, aunque se valorarán niveles superiores." NO Spanish requirement — Unizar's general rule only demands proof of Spanish where the master is taught in Spanish, which this one is not.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 (DECRETO del Gobierno de Aragón de 24 de junio de 2026, BOA 29/06/2026; official Unizar price table 'Enseñanzas de Máster Universitario. Precios Públicos: Curso académico 2026-2027')
non_eu_surcharge: YES — CONFIRMED, EXACTLY DOUBLE, AND UNAVOIDABLE ON A STUDENT VISA. The Unizar 2026-27 master price table has a dedicated non-EU row: for EINA masters including 'Robótica, Gráficos y Visión por Computador/Robotics, Graphics and Computer Vision' the entry reads '30,40 / 60,80' — 30,40 EUR/ECTS for 'Españoles, residentes o ciudadanos UE 1ª matrícula' and 60,80 EUR/ECTS for 'Ciudadanos no UE / Non-EU citizens. Credit price 1st. Registration' (2nd enrolment 60,76 / 121,52). Crucially, Unizar states verbatim: "La condición de residente se acreditará mediante la tarjeta de Identificación de Extranjeros (TIE) donde se indique que el tipo de permiso es por RESIDENCIA. El permiso por ESTANCIA o permiso por ESTUDIOS no es válido para acreditar la condición de residente, a efectos del pago de los precios de matrícula." A Tunisian arriving on a student visa therefore pays the non-EU rate. Unizar does publish an 'AYUDAS DE MATRÍCULA para estudiantes extranjeros no residentes' call that can offset this.
entry_requirements: Access degrees, verbatim: "Ingeniería Informática; Ingeniería Electrónica y Automática (1); Ingeniería de Tecnologías Industriales (1); Ingeniería de Tecnologías y Servicios de Telecomunicación (1); Ingeniería Mecatrónica (1); Ingeniería Eléctrica (1); Ingeniería Mecánica (1); Física (1); Matemáticas (1); Otros títulos universitarios oficiales de grado en Ingeniería o Ciencias (1, 2)". Verbatim on the (1)/(2) markers: "Para las titulaciones marcadas (1), (1, 2), para el acceso directo al Máster deberá además acreditarse: (1) 18 créditos ECTS cursados (o experiencia equivalente, por ejemplo el TFG) de programación de computadores, y (2) 18 créditos ECTS cursados (o experiencia equivalente) de matemáticas." A non-EHEA degree without homologación needs a Unizar 'autorización de acceso' resolution first (access route (e)).
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT AND UNCONDITIONAL. 'Ingeniería Informática' is the FIRST listed access degree and carries NO (1) or (2) marker, i.e. it is direct access with no programming or mathematics evidence required. This is the cleanest background match in the batch.
complementary_credits_required: RUCT (for the TITLE): NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — the Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos row is absent (null) for 4317156. Unizar admission page (for the APPLICANT): this master does not run "complementos de formación" at all; instead it gates DIRECT ACCESS on evidence of prior credits. Verbatim: "Ingeniería Informática" is listed UNMARKED, i.e. direct access with no extra evidence. Every other listed degree carries marker (1) and/or (2): "Para las titulaciones marcadas (1), (1, 2), para el acceso directo al Máster deberá además acreditarse: (1) 18 créditos ECTS cursados (o experiencia equivalente, por ejemplo el TFG) de programación de computadores, y (2) 18 créditos ECTS cursados (o experiencia equivalente) de matemáticas." A foreign software engineering degree falls formally under "Otros títulos universitarios oficiales de grado en Ingeniería o Ciencias (1, 2)", so on the published wording it must document BOTH 18 ECTS of programming AND 18 ECTS of mathematics — easily met by a 300-ECTS software engineering degree, but it must be evidenced in the CV (the page asks for languages used, credit estimates, even estimated lines of code). Additional hard requirement for everyone: "Para todos los títulos deberá acreditarse al menos nivel B2 de Inglés o equivalente, aunque se valorarán niveles superiores."
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND as an advanced-standing rule for a 300-ECTS degree. Unizar has a general 'Reconocimiento y Transferencia de créditos' regime (linked from academico.unizar.es). The programme does state that external internships can be credit-recognised: "El reconocimiento en créditos de la realización de prácticas externas esta limitado a un máximo de 9 ECTS y podrá realizarse en segmentos diferenciados de 3 ECTS."
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. Unizar's published 2026-2027 master admission phases (verbatim): Fase 1 (except Máster en Profesorado) 'Presentación solicitudes: 2 al 23 de marzo de 2026', definitive lists 17 April 2026, payment 20-27 April 2026; Fase 2 'Presentación solicitudes: Del 11 al 26 de junio de 2026', definitive lists 17 July 2026; Fase 3 'Presentación solicitudes: del 24 al 31 de agosto de 2026', definitive lists 14 September 2026. Enrolment windows 22-24 July 2026 and 16-17 September 2026.
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES. A non-EHEA, non-homologated degree requires a separate prior 'Solicitud de Acceso' / autorización de acceso (academico.unizar.es → 'acceso con estudios extranjeros no homologados obtenidos fuera del Espacio'), which must be resolved before the general admission application. Target Fase 1 (March).
admissions_contact_email: grado.master@unizar.es (Sección de Grado y Máster, tel. +34 976 76 10 43). Programme coordinator: Ana Cristina Murillo Arnal (Escuela de Ingeniería y Arquitectura, Calle María de Luna 3, Zaragoza, tel. 976761864).
curriculum_summary: 90 ECTS = 42 compulsory + 18 optional (internships included) + 30 TFM, spread over 3 semesters. MANDATORY (6 ECTS each): 69150 Autonomous Robots (S1), 69151 Computer Vision (S1), 69152 Machine Learning (S1), 69153 Modeling and Simulation of Appearance (S1), 69154 Programming and Architecture of Computing Systems (S1), 69155 Computational Imaging (S2), 69156 Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (S2). OPTIONAL (3 ECTS each): 69168 Fundamentals of Computing for RGCV, 69157 Virtual Reality, 69158 Applications of Deep Learning, 69159 Advanced SLAM, 69160 Multirobot Systems, 69161 Assistive Robotics, 69169 Advanced Computational Imaging, 69170 Advanced Computer Vision, 69171 Research and Innovation Activities, 69164/69165/69166 Professional Internships 1-3. 69167 Trabajo Fin de Máster 30 ECTS (S3). Verbatim: "El título consta de 90 créditos ECTS en total... las materias obligatorias suponen 42 créditos ECTS, 18 créditos corresponden a materias optativas, incluyendo la realización de prácticas externas, y los 30 créditos ECTS restantes corresponden al Trabajo Fin de Máster."
notable_faculty_or_lab: Two internationally leading Unizar groups, described verbatim on the page: the Grupo de Robótica, Percepción y Tiempo Real — "el grupo de investigación de España con mayor impacto internacional en el ámbito de la robótica y uno de los de mayor impacto de Europa... incluyendo siete de los diez artículos más citados de la robótica española" (J.D. Tardós, J.M. Martínez Montiel — ORB-SLAM lineage); and the Graphics and Imaging Lab, which "ha recibido una de las pocas ERC Consolidator Grants de la Unión Europea en temas de informática gráfica (D. Gutiérrez)" and hosts "la primera investigadora española que recibe el Eurographics Young Researcher Award (B. Masiá)". Coordinator: Ana Cristina Murillo Arnal. Feeds the Programa de Doctorado en Ingeniería de Sistemas e Informática (I3A).
industry_links: Exceptionally strong and named on the page. Collaborating companies, verbatim: "Nacionales: Ábaco Digital, Atria Innovation, BitBrain, Exovite, Buavi (antes EyeLinx), Gas Natural, Indra, Sistemas, Infaimón, IT Corporate, Libelium, Robotnik, Scati Labs, Solid Angle, Tecnitop, Telnet. Internacionales: Adobe, Alibaba, Boeing, Disney, Epic Games, Google, Infineon, Kuka, Meta, Microsoft, nuTonomy, Nvidia, Oculus VR, Panasonic." Later additions include Amazon, Ericsson, German Aerospace Center, Intel, Leica, Orbem, Qualcomm, Voca. Recent doctoral graduates placed at Google, Adobe, Nvidia, Intel, Disney Research, Oculus VR, ETH Zurich, EPFL.
thesis_or_internship: TFM 30 ECTS (S3), written as an article/report IN ENGLISH and defended conference-style; may be done at EINA, at a partner company, or at a mobility-agreement university. Professional Internships available as 3x3 ECTS optional subjects (max 9 ECTS recognisable).

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario Erasmus Mundus en Ciencia de Datos Lingüísticos
programme_name_en: Erasmus Mundus Master in Linguistic Data Science (EMLDS / CLiDS)
institution: CONSORTIUM (Erasmus Mundus Joint Master). Spanish partner and RUCT registrant: Universidad de Zaragoza (Escuela de Ingeniería y Arquitectura). Full consortium as registered in RUCT: Universidad de Zaragoza; National University of Ireland, Galway / Ollscoil na hÉireann, Gaillimh (Ireland); Universidade Nova de Lisboa (Portugal); Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore - Milano (Italy).
city: Mobility across Lisbon or Milan (S1), Zaragoza (S2 and S3), student's choice (S4)
official_status: máster universitario (Erasmus Mundus Joint Master — joint degree)
modality: presencial (with compulsory international mobility)
language_of_instruction: ENGLISH. Verbatim from the consortium site: "120 ECTS, English-taught master's programme leading to a Joint Degree".
language_requirement: Verbatim: the consortium requires "a minimum proficiency level of CEFR B2.2 (or equivalent) for admission". Exemptions for native English speakers and for applicants whose degree was "taught entirely in English"; otherwise a recognised English test result is mandatory. No Spanish requirement.
tuition_year_of_rates: Rate quoted on the consortium's Costs and Funding page as at 2026-08-25, for the full four-semester study period; the page does not label it by cohort year, and the currently advertised cohort is 2027-2029.
non_eu_surcharge: no — the Costs and Funding page publishes one figure (EUR 18,000) with no Programme Country / Partner Country distinction. This is an EMJM consortium fee, not a Spanish public-price decree, so the Aragón decreto de precios públicos does not apply.
entry_requirements: Verbatim: applicants must have "completed a bachelor's degree from a recognised higher education institution" with "a minimum of 180 ECTS credits". No specific degree field is mandated. Unizar states two expected profiles, verbatim: "1) graduados en áreas científico-técnicas, con habilidades en programación, matemáticas y estadísticas y 2) graduados en humanidades y ciencias del lenguaje, con habilidades en lingüística y ciencias sociales". Documents: passport/ID; bachelor's diploma; transcript of records; CV in English; motivation letter "maximum 500 words, in English"; English proficiency certificate; two recommendation letters. Selection weighting, verbatim: "Academic merit and relevant professional experience (40%)", "Motivation letter (35%)", "Letters of recommendation (25%)".
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT. Profile 1 is exactly a science/engineering graduate with programming, mathematics and statistics skills.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT — 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' = 0 for 3500872). The consortium imposes no bridging credits; entry is by 180-ECTS minimum, which a 300-ECTS degree comfortably exceeds.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND. Joint-degree EMJM curricula are fixed by the consortium agreement and mobility scheme; no advanced-standing or credit-recognition provision is published, and none should be assumed.
application_window_2027: A 2027-2029 COHORT IS ANNOUNCED, DATES NOT YET RELEASED. The consortium's Applications Timeline page lists, for the 2027-2029 cohort: "Call Opening: Date to be announced", "Call Closure: Date to be announced", "Interviews: If and when requested by the Joint Admissions Committee", "Final Results: Date to be announced", "Final Acceptance by Students: Date to be announced". The timeline is stated for "EMJM Scholarship and Non-Scholarship Holders" together, i.e. a single unified deadline rather than separate scholarship and self-funded tracks. THIS PAGE MUST BE RE-CHECKED — EMJM calls typically open in the autumn preceding the intake (i.e. late 2026) and close in the winter/early spring.
application_rounds: 2027-2029 cohort: single call, opening and closing dates 'to be announced' as at 2026-08-25
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — CRITICAL. There is one unified call and no rolling admission; missing it means waiting a full cohort cycle. Set a monitoring reminder on https://emlds.fcsh.unl.pt/whentoapply/ from autumn 2026.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND on the pages read — the consortium routes contact through https://emlds.fcsh.unl.pt/program/team/ . Spanish-side administrative contact: grado.master@unizar.es
curriculum_summary: 120 ECTS over 4 semesters (30 each) with compulsory mobility: Semester 1 at Universidade NOVA de Lisboa (Portugal) OR Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Milan (Italy); Semester 2 at Universidad de Zaragoza; Semester 3 at Universidad de Zaragoza; Semester 4 at a "University chosen based on the student's preference". RUCT breakdown: 75 obligatorios + 15 optativos + 30 TFM. Content (Unizar, verbatim): implicit representation of linguistic aspects — "semántica distribucional, embeddings, análisis de semántica latente" — and explicit representation — "terminologías, diccionarios, ontologías, corpus anotados"; "Los estudiantes serán entrenados en técnicas de aprendizaje automático y aprendizaje profundo para su uso en el análisis y procesamiento de datos léxicos y textuales, así como en la Web Semántica y en datos lingüísticos enlazados." Curriculum page for the current edition: https://emlds.fcsh.unl.pt/curriculum-2026-2028/
notable_faculty_or_lab: Four-university consortium coordinated from NOVA FCSH (Lisbon); Spanish teaching at Unizar EINA. NOT FOUND: named individual faculty on the pages read.
industry_links: Framed as "transferencia tecnológica" with graduates entering "equipos de empresas, administraciones públicas o universidades". NOT FOUND: named partner companies.
thesis_or_internship: TFM 30 ECTS (RUCT). No compulsory internship recorded (0 ECTS prácticas).

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Inteligencia Artificial Aplicada a la Industria e Ingeniería Asistida por Ordenador
programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Artificial Intelligence Applied to Industry and Computer-Aided Engineering
institution: Universidad del País Vasco / Euskal Herriko Unibertsitatea (UPV/EHU) — Escuela de Ingeniería de Vitoria-Gasteiz
modality: presencial
language_of_instruction: CASTELLANO (Spanish) ONLY. Programme page header reads "Idioma: Castellano". The official programa confirms it subject by subject: all 15 compulsory subjects are listed with "Idiomas: Castellano" — Análisis, Simulación y Experimentación de Sistemas Mecánicos; Aprendizaje Automático Aplicado al Control Inteligente Industrial; Aprendizaje por Refuerzo; Big Data; Ciberseguridad Industrial; Hardware Específico para IAI; IA Aplicada a la Detección de Defectos y Anomalías en la Industria; Metodología de la Investigación; Programación Científica en Python; Redes Neuronales y Aprendizaje Profundo; Simulación Fluido Dinámica Computacional; Simulación y Optimización FEM de Componentes Industriales; Simulación y Optimización de Procesos de Fabricación; Simulación y Optimización de Procesos en Plantas Industriales; Visión Artificial. No English or Basque teaching group.
language_requirement: No minimum certificate is required for entry, but English and Basque certificates SCORE in admission — verbatim from the merit table: "Otros: Inglés y Euskera. Se requerirán certificados oficiales. (5%)". Spanish is required in practice (100% castellano delivery) and this is the binding constraint for this candidate.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27. Verbatim: "Los precios públicos que se aplican a estas matrículas son los aprobados por el Gobierno Vasco para el curso 2026-2027 mediante Orden de 1 de junio de 2026" (BOPV nº 113, 17 June 2026).
non_eu_surcharge: NO — with an unusually strong negative. The Basque price order for 2026-27 contains NO non-EU clause at all: a full-text search of the Orden de 1 de junio de 2026 (BOPV nº113, 17/06/2026) for 'no comunitario', 'extracomunitario' and 'Unión Europea' returns zero matches, and neither Anexo II (standard prices by experimentalidad) nor Anexo III (másteres con precio diferenciado) contains any nationality- or residence-based row. Price is set purely by experimentalidad and enrolment number. This master is NOT in the Anexo III differentiated list, so the standard Anexo II grade-3 rate (Ingeniería y Arquitectura) applies to everyone. Contrast with Aragón (Unizar) and Comunitat Valenciana (UA/UPV), which both double the price for non-EU non-residents.
entry_requirements: Titulaciones de acceso, verbatim: "(Grado en) Ingeniería Electrónica; (Grado en) Ingeniería Mecánica; (Grado en) Ingeniería Química Industrial; Grado en Ingeniería Aeroespacial; Grado en Ingeniería Electrónica Industrial y Automática; Grado en Ingeniería Informática; Grado en Ingeniería Informática de Gestión y Sistemas de Información; Grado en Ingeniería Mecatrónica; Grado en Ingeniería Robótica; Grado en Ingeniería de Energías Renovables; Grado en Ingeniería en Automoción; Grado en Ingeniería en Innovación de Procesos y Productos; Grado/Licenciatura en Ingeniería Civil; Otros grados o titulaciones equivalentes a las anteriores a criterio de la Com. Académica". Merit scoring, verbatim: Titulación 75% ("Idoneidad del título de acceso al máster (expediente académico): 1) Las titulaciones que se consideren más idóneas, se les ponderará la nota del expediente académico x1. 2) Las titulaciones con idoneidad media-alta, x 0.85. 3) Las titulaciones con idoneidad baja, x 0.5"); Méritos de investigación 10%; Experiencia profesional 10% ("Se valorará la experiencia de los últimos cinco años"); Otros (Inglés y Euskera, official certificates required) 5%. 25 places. Foreign non-EHEA degree holders must supply a legalised/apostilled degree, official transcripts with course hours, and obtain an "Autorización para cursar estudios de máster en la UPV/EHU" from the university's Postgraduate Commission.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT. "Grado en Ingeniería Informática" is a named access degree. Note the 75%-weighted idoneidad multiplier: Computer Engineering should score in the top or near-top band for an AI master, but the exact banding is not published.
complementary_credits_required: For the TITLE (RUCT 3500052): 'NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT' — the register does not publish the Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos row for this title (null, which is NOT the same as 0). For the APPLICANT: UPV/EHU publishes no dedicated 'acceso y admisión' page for this master (both /acceso-y-admision and /admision return HTTP 404); access requirements are handled centrally. Applicant-level complementos = NOT FOUND. What IS established: art. 1.c of the Basque price Orden states 'A los créditos a realizar en su caso, como complementos de formación, por el estudiantado matriculado en un Máster Universitario, se les aplicará el precio público correspondiente a dicho Máster Universitario' — i.e. complementos exist as a mechanism and are billed at the master's own rate. Credit recognition / advanced standing for a 300-ECTS degree: NOT FOUND.
credit_recognition_available: PARTIAL / GENERAL ONLY. UPV/EHU operates credit recognition and the Basque order prices it, verbatim: "El estudiantado que en los estudios de Grado o Máster Universitario obtenga reconocimiento de créditos abonará el 25 % de los precios establecidos en los anexos I, II, III y IV." NOT FOUND: any programme-level advanced-standing rule for a 300-ECTS degree.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. UPV/EHU's published 2026/2027 master preinscription phases (verbatim): "Del 2 al 27 de marzo" (Phase 1), "Del 25 al 29 de mayo" (Phase 2), "Del 1 al 3 de julio" (Phase 3). One master per phase. Verbatim on priority: "el alumnado que se preinscriba en dicho plazo tendrá preferencia en la asignación de plazas" (Phase 1). Later phases open only where places remain.
application_rounds: 2026-27 Phase 1: 2-27 March 2026 (priority in place allocation) | 2026-27 Phase 2: 25-29 May 2026 | 2026-27 Phase 3: 1-3 July 2026
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES. A non-EHEA degree needs legalisation/apostille plus an 'Autorización para cursar estudios de máster en la UPV/EHU' from the Postgraduate Commission before a place can be confirmed; with 25 places and explicit Phase-1 priority, Phase 1 (March) is the round to target.
admissions_contact_email: secretaria.ei-vi@ehu.eus (Secretaría, Escuela de Ingeniería de Vitoria-Gasteiz). Master coordinator: Ekaitz Zulueta Guerrero — ekaitz.zulueta@ehu.eus
curriculum_summary: Verbatim: "El programa tiene una duración de un curso académico, con 15 asignaturas que suman 48 ECTS y un Trabajo Fin de Máster de 12 ECTS." Carga lectiva: 48 obligatorias + 0 optativas + 12 TFM = 60 ECTS (matches RUCT exactly). AI strand: Aprendizaje Automático Aplicado al Control Inteligente Industrial (4,5), Programación Científica en Python (4,5), Aprendizaje por Refuerzo (3), Redes Neuronales y Aprendizaje Profundo (3), Visión Artificial (3), Big Data (3), IA Aplicada a la Detección de Defectos y Anomalías en la Industria (3), Hardware Específico para IAI (3), Ciberseguridad Industrial (3), Metodología de la Investigación (3). CAE/simulation strand: Análisis, Simulación y Experimentación de Sistemas Mecánicos (3), Simulación Fluido Dinámica Computacional (3), Simulación y Optimización FEM de Componentes Industriales (3), Simulación y Optimización de Procesos de Fabricación Aplicados a Componentes Industriales (3), Simulación y Optimización de Procesos en Plantas Industriales (3). Proyecto Fin de Máster 12 ECTS. NOTE: roughly a third of the taught load is mechanical/fluid/FEM simulation rather than AI.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Escuela de Ingeniería de Vitoria-Gasteiz. Master coordinator Ekaitz Zulueta Guerrero. Quality documentation: Memoria verificada, Informe final de evaluación de Unibasq, Resolución del Consejo de Universidades, plus 2023/24 and 2024/25 autoinformes, all published on the programme's Acreditación page.
industry_links: Verbatim from the '4 razones': "Da respuesta a las necesidades de empresas del entorno en el ámbito de la IA industrial e Ingenieria Asistida por Ordenador"; "posibilidad de realizar prácticas en un amplio espectro de empresas"; "Oportunidad de participar en proyectos de I+D que el profesorado del máster lleva a cabo con dichas empresas". NOT FOUND: named companies.
thesis_or_internship: Proyecto Fin de Máster 12 ECTS. Company placements available (Prácticas page) but not credited in the 60-ECTS plan (0 ECTS optativas, 0 prácticas in RUCT).

programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Data Science
institution_type: private (public-interest foundation; official Catalan university, AQU-accredited)
modality: online (100%)
language_of_instruction: SPANISH or CATALAN — NOT ENGLISH. Verbatim from the programme page header: "Idiomas: Español, Catalán" and "El mismo programa se ofrece en las dos lenguas en aulas diferentes". The two languages are separate virtual classrooms of the same programme; the applicant picks one at the access request ("En qué idioma prefieres realizar tus estudios? Español / Catalán"). language_requirement: English is RECOMMENDED, not required, and is a reading requirement rather than a teaching language. Verbatim under Conocimientos previos: "Se recomienda un nivel de competencia en lengua inglesa equivalente al B2 del Marco común europeo de referencia para las lenguas." Spanish (or Catalan) at study level is required in practice.

non_eu_surcharge: YES — EXPLICIT AND SUBSTANTIAL. UOC publishes two separate price blocks. "Precios para estudiantes de la Unión Europea": "Precio por crédito 25,82 €/cr", "Precio por crédito herramientas y recursos para el aprendizaje 18,30 €/cr", "Precio por crédito de asignaturas convalidadas 5,16 €/cr", "Precio orientativo a tiempo completo (1 año): 2.900,00 €". "Precios para estudiantes de fuera de la Unión Europea": A tiempo completo (1 año) 4.330 € (hasta 9 cuotas); A tiempo parcial (2 años) 4.840 € (hasta 17 cuotas). So a non-EU student pays 4.330 EUR against 2.900 EUR — roughly +49% (+1.430 EUR) full-time, or +1.940 EUR part-time. Caveat printed by UOC: "Precios vigentes en el momento de formalizar la matrícula. El precio final de la matrícula será el resultante de su formalización efectiva."
entry_requirements: Requisitos académicos: an official university degree. UOC routes non-EHEA applicants explicitly — one of the four declared situations is "He cursado estudios universitarios oficiales en Latinoamérica o en otros países de fuera del espacio europeo de educación superior (EEES) y no tengo el título homologado", handled through the tutor after requesting access. Access request itself is free: "La solicitud de acceso es un trámite gratuito y sin compromiso". Documentation must be sent "en el plazo de los diez días siguientes a la formalización de la matrícula". RECOMMENDED ENTRY PROFILE (RD 822/2021 Anexo I knowledge fields), verbatim: "Ingeniería informática y de sistemas. Ingeniería eléctrica, ingeniería electrónica e ingeniería de la telecomunicación. Matemáticas y Estadística. Física y Astronomía. Ingeniería industrial, ingeniería mecánica, ingeniería automática, ingeniería de la organización industrial e ingeniería de la navegación. Ingeniería química, ingeniería de los materiales e ingeniería del medio natural." Verbatim on non-listed backgrounds: "Este Máster universitario en Ciencia de Datos está orientado principalmente a perfiles del ámbito de las ingenierías" — applicants from other fields are admitted only if they hold ALL of: basic mathematics (min. 150 h — probability/statistics, linear algebra); intermediate programming (min. 300 h — variables/functions, structured programming, OOP fundamentals, abstract data types); basic relational databases (min. 150 h — relational design, Entity-Relationship model, SQL); and introductory networks and computer architecture (min. 150 h — CPU/memory, operating systems, IP networks/Internet protocols, Linux at user level). "Dichos conocimientos serán evaluados por la Comisión de Admisión del máster." A preparatory course (6 subjects x 6 credits) exists for those who lack them.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT AND OPTIMAL. "Ingeniería informática y de sistemas" is the FIRST listed recommended knowledge field, and the four prior-knowledge blocks (maths, programming, databases, networks/architecture) are precisely a Software Engineering curriculum. UOC even steers non-technical applicants AWAY to a different master.
complementary_credits_required: 12 ECTS — COMPULSORY FOR EVERYONE, and this is NOT in RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos = null for 4316294). Verbatim from the programme's own plan de estudios: "Para obtener la titulación de máster universitario de Ciencia de datos el estudiante tiene que superar 60 créditos ECTS entre asignaturas obligatorias y optativas y, además, 12 créditos ECTS de asignaturas niveladoras de complementos de formación." And on timing: "Este máster está adaptado al nuevo RD 822/2021 y tiene la restricción de matricular obligatoriamente las dos asignaturas de complementos de formación durante el primer curso académico, preferentemente el primer semestre... No se podrá continuar los estudios hasta que no se superen los complementos. Los complementos de formación son conocimientos de grado obligatorios para titularse del master." Every study plan on the page repeats the footnote "En esta planificación no se incluyen los 12 ECTS de complementos de formación, adicionales y obligatorios para titularse." ==> THE REAL LOAD IS 72 ECTS, NOT 60, AND THE REAL COST IS HIGHER THAN THE HEADLINE.
credit_recognition_available: YES — TWO NAMED MECHANISMS, and the most explicit credit-recognition route in this batch. Verbatim: "No debéis cursar en vuestro programa de estudios las asignaturas reconocidas mediante la evaluación de estudios previos (EEP) o del reconocimiento académico de la experiencia profesional (RAEP). Una vez se han incorporado a la matrícula, los créditos reconocidos se descuentan del total de créditos que hay que cursar para obtener el título." Recognised subjects are also charged at a reduced rate: "Precio por crédito de asignaturas convalidadas: 5,16 €/cr" (against 25,82 €/cr). THIS IS THE 300-ECTS LEVER: a 300-ECTS Software Engineering degree is the natural case for EEP against the 12 ECTS of complementos and possibly against core subjects. NOT FOUND: any published cap or guarantee — the outcome is decided case by case after requesting access.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. UOC does not run fixed admission rounds — it runs semester intakes with rolling enrolment. The published next intake is "Inicio: 23 sept 2026". TFM 12 ECTS. entry_requirements: Academic/administrative (Berklee graduate application, verbatim): online application; "statement of purpose" "between 400 and 500 words"; résumé/CV in English; "One letter of recommendation from a professional colleague or professor (not peers)"; official undergraduate transcripts; "Credential evaluation (if educated outside US/Canada)" — REQUIRED for a Tunisian degree; English proficiency test; bachelor's degree diploma before enrolment; "$150 non-refundable" application fee. curriculum_summary: Page header: "Curriculum and Courses 2026-2027 Academic Year". 60 ECTS / 34–35 US credits in three modules. FINAL PROJECT (Módulo TFM): one practicum tied to the chosen concentration — MB-611 Entrepreneurship (4) OR MB-621 Live (4) OR MB-623 Record (4) — plus MB-695 Culminating Experience (6). ELECTIVES (Módulo Optativas): four courses, 12 credits total (1 Fall, 2 Spring, 1 Summer), from MTI-613 Electronic Dance Music Composition (3); MB-614 The Art of Live Entertainment (3); MB-665 The Culture and Business of Emerging Technologies and New Creative Frontiers (3); MB-557 Economics of Creative Industries (3); MB-613 The Science of Artist Management (3); MB-626 A&R and Music Artistry (3); MB-555 Global Leadership and Management (3); MB-627 Globalization and Emerging Markets (3); MB-559 Publishing and Music Supervision (3); MTI-543 Studio Video Music Production (3); MB-615 The Business of Music Marketing (3); MB-550 Music Brands and Partnerships (3); GS-595 Graduate Internship (1). GS-510 Principles of Music Research (1) is optional and does NOT count toward the degree. CONCENTRATIONS (choose one, and it drives both practicum and final project): "Live Entertainment, Entrepreneurship, and Record Industry". PATH FIT — the strongest P/S match in this batch and the one that touches this candidate's own practice: the Record Industry concentration is path P almost exactly (copyright and contract management, publishing and music supervision, A&R), the Live Entertainment concentration is path S almost exactly (The Art of Live Entertainment plus the Live practicum), and 'MB-563 Data Analytics in the Music Industry' is a genuine, if small, bridge to path X/AB. RUCT records prácticas externas = 0, consistent with the internship being optional.

language_requirement: B1 or higher in Spanish (castellano) for applicants with foreign qualifications, to be accredited by 25 September 2026 for the 2026-27 intake (unirioja.es admission procedure). RELEVANT: the candidate is at A0/A1 today.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2024-25 — the rate table carried on the unirioja.es precios académicos page at the access date; no later table was published there. Treat the figure as the latest published, not as a confirmed 2026-27 or 2027-28 rate.

entry_requirements: Recommended profiles: 'Grado en Ingeniería Informática', other engineering specialities, Mathematics, Physics, Bioinformatics or related fields. Graduates of other degrees may be admitted if they demonstrate the competences or complete complementary training.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — explicit; computing and other engineering degrees are the recommended profiles
complementary_credits_required: For the TITLE (RUCT 4317075): 'NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT' — the register publishes no Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos row (null, not 0). Graduates of Ingeniería Informática, other Ingenierías, Matemáticas, Física, Bioinformática, Biotecnología 'u otras titulaciones afines' do not require complementos; verbatim for everyone else: 'Podrán exigirse complementos de formación a los egresados en otras titulaciones', decided case by case by the Comisión Académica, requiring accredited competences in matemáticas, estadística e informática and takeable 'con carácter previo o de forma simultánea al máster'. No ECTS volume is published for them. A Tunisian software engineering degree falls squarely in the exempt group — but the Comisión Académica retains case-by-case discretion, so treat exemption as very likely rather than guaranteed. Advanced standing for the 300-ECTS length: NOT FOUND; the only recognition route published is up to 9 ECTS of external placements recognisable against accredited work experience.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND — no advanced standing or reconocimiento rule published on the programme page for a 300-ECTS first degree
application_window_2027: 2026-27 CALENDAR ONLY (2027-28 not published): ordinary preinscripción 20 May – 22 June 2026; extraordinary 17–30 July 2026 and 18 August – 3 September 2026; exceptional 15 September – 1 October 2026 and 15 October 2026 – 28 January 2027. programme_name_en: Erasmus Mundus Master Degree in Waves, Acoustics, Vibrations, Engineering and Sound (WAVES)
institution: Conjunto Internacional — Universitat Politècnica de València (ES, Campus de Gandia); Universidade de Coimbra (PT); Aix-Marseille Université (FR); École Centrale de Marseille / Centrale Méditerranée (FR)
institution_type: public (international joint consortium / Erasmus Mundus Joint Master)
city: Gandia (Valencia) for the Spanish semester; Coimbra (PT), Marseille (FR) for the others
official_status: máster universitario (official, Conjunto Internacional). RUCT estado: 'Publicado en B.O.E.'; nivel académico Máster - RD 1393/2007, MECES 3; fecha de verificación 11/03/2021; BOE 15/01/2022. The UPV programme page additionally states 'Title in the process of renewal'.
modality: presencial (mobility across 3 countries)
language_of_instruction: English. Consortium FAQ verbatim: 'All courses are taught in English so that English proficiency is required.' UPV programme page states language: 'English'.
language_requirement: English proficiency required. Consortium FAQ accepts CEFR B2 certificates, Cambridge English First, TOEFL or IELTS, or proof of 6+ months of academic/professional experience in an English-speaking country. No Spanish requirement (Spanish semester is taught in English).
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 (UPV 'Importe de los derechos y precios públicos de máster oficial', Decreto 101/2024 de 2 de agosto del Consell; 2027-28 rates NOT YET PUBLISHED)
non_eu_surcharge: YES — CONFIRMED, and it is a 100% surcharge (double price). UPV tariff sheet, section 'Precios públicos para el estudiantado extranjero', verbatim: 'Al estudiantado de nuevo ingreso extranjero, que no tenga la condición de residente, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea y aquellos a quienes les sea de aplicación el régimen comunitario, se les aplicará el doble de los precios públicos establecidos para cada titulación.' It also closes the residency loophole verbatim: 'la autorización de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros de acuerdo con el Real Decreto 557/2011 ... no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes.' Base Erasmus Mundus rate 39.27 EUR/credit -> 78.54 EUR/credit for a Tunisian non-resident. ARITHMETIC: 39.27 x 2 = 78.54; 78.54 x 120 = 9,424.80. The UPV programme page quotes only the undoubled figure (39.27 EUR/credit = 4,712.40 for 120 credits, 'for both Type 1 and Type 2 students'), which does NOT reflect the non-EU doubling. NOTE: an EMJM scholarship normally covers participation costs in full — see scholarships_internal.
entry_requirements: UPV admission page: 'an official Spanish university degree or other equivalent degree issued by a higher education institution belonging to the European Higher Education Area'; a bachelor's degree in acoustics or a related field — Telecommunication, Sound and Image Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture 'or equivalent'. Selection on academic record, adequacy of prior training to the master profile, professional or research experience, and motivation. English proficiency (B2 or equivalent) required.
accepts_engineering_background: PARTIAL / RISK — INFERRED, not explicit. The named entry profiles are acoustics-adjacent engineering (telecommunications, sound & image systems, industrial, mechanical, architecture) plus 'or equivalent'. A pure Software Engineering degree is NOT named. A candidate with no acoustics/physics/signal-processing coursework is at real risk of being judged inadequate on 'adecuación de la formación al perfil del máster'. Do NOT record this as an accepted background.
complementary_credits_required: TWO ANSWERS. (a) FOR THE TITLE, from RUCT: 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' is NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (null in the register extract — this is NOT the same as 0). (b) FOR THE APPLICANT: NOT FOUND. The UPV titulaciones page gives no complementos de formación detail, and the consortium's own admission pages are unreachable (404 / platform withdrawn), so no applicant-level bridging rule could be established. Note that at 120 ECTS this is a two-year title, so a 300-ECTS entrant has no bridging problem but also no published advanced-standing route — NOT FOUND on credit recognition.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND. Neither the UPV admission page nor the consortium site addresses reconocimiento de créditos or advanced standing for a 300-ECTS entrant. UPV publishes a fee for 'Estudio de solicitudes de convalidación de asignaturas o de reconocimiento de créditos correspondiente a estudios extranjeros' (143,73 EUR), which shows the procedure exists, but no programme-level rule was found.
application_window_2027: ⚠️ APPEARS NOT TO RUN FOR A 2027 INTAKE — this is the most consequential finding on this record. The WAVES Consortium Committee announced on 1 October 2025 that it is reworking the programme and DECIDED NOT TO OPEN THE RECRUITMENT CAMPAIGN FOR A 2026-2028 COHORT; the consortium site states 'The application platform is therefore unavailable' and /applications and /admission now return HTTP 404. UPV's own titulaciones page independently shows places offered as 'No disponible (curso 26-27)' and the title as 'Título en proceso de renovación'. NO 2027-2029 cohort has been announced. For completeness, UPV's GENERIC master admission phases for curso 2026-27 (marked 2026-27, NOT shifted forward, and NOT confirmed to apply to this title given no places are offered): Fase 0 (international students from outside the EU) 17 noviembre 2025 – 13 febrero 2026; Fase 1 (all) 2 marzo – 30 abril 2026; Fase 2 (all) 15–26 junio 2026; Fase 3 (all) 31 julio – 7 agosto y 24 agosto – 4 septiembre 2026. NOTE the Fase 0 non-EU early round: UPV does run a dedicated earlier window for extracomunitarios.

For EMJM funding the binding deadline is the consortium's own scholarship round (historically autumn/winter of the preceding academic year), not the UPV phases.

curriculum_summary: 120 ECTS over 2 years, 4 semesters, 3 countries. RUCT breakdown: 90 ECTS obligatorios + 30 ECTS TFM, 0 optativos, 0 prácticas. Mobility: S1 Universidade de Coimbra (PT); S2 Universitat Politècnica de València, Gandia campus (ES); S3 Aix-Marseille Université + Centrale Méditerranée (FR); S4 internship/thesis placement, described by the consortium as 'worldwide' across 20 Associated Partners and 21 Industrial Partners. Awards multiple national master degrees plus a Joint Diploma Supplement.
