programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Computación y Tecnología Empresarial
programme_name_en: Master in Computer Science and Business Technology (MCSBT)
institution: IE Universidad — IE School of Science & Technology
city: Madrid (IE Tower); university seat registered in Segovia, Castilla y León
autonomous_community: Madrid (teaching) / Castilla y León (university seat per RUCT)
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL) — CONFLICT RESOLVED IN FAVOUR OF OFFICIAL. RUCT 3500706, estado 'Publicado en B.O.E.', nivel académico 'Máster - RD 822/2021', MECES 3, fecha de verificación 18/07/2025, BOE 13/10/2025 and 01/01/2026, active. IE's own programme page independently confirms it: verbatim 'graduates of this official master's program are also eligible to pursue a Ph.D.' — PhD access is the operative marker of an official title and IE would not claim it for a título propio. See conflicts[] for the contradicting IE PDF.
modality: presencial (IE page: 'Full-time', 'In-person')
language_of_instruction: English. IE programme page fact bar, verbatim: 'duration / language / location / intake ... 11 Months / English / Madrid / September'. No Spanish-language component stated. NOTE per brief rule 7: IE publishes an English-first site, but this is the fact bar of the programme page itself, not a translated version of a Spanish plan; the official RUCT title is bilingual ('Computación y Tecnología Empresarial / Computer Science and Business Technology'). Treat as English-taught, with the RUCT-registered plan not separately inspected for a language field.
language_requirement: English certificate required unless exempt. Verbatim: 'English language certificate - we accept the TOEFL (minimum score of 100 but 105 recommended), the IELTS (minimum score of 7 but 7.5 recommended), Duolingo English Test (minimum score 130) or a Cambridge Advanced level. A certificate is not required if you are a native speaker, you completed an undergraduate degree in English, you have worked and lived for more than two years in an English speaking country, or if you have extensive professional experience in English.' Certificates valid two years from the exam date. NO SPANISH REQUIREMENT — this programme is not blocked by the candidate's A0/A1 Spanish.
tuition_year_of_rates: Rate published on the IE admissions & fees page as at 2026-08-25, footnoted 'Tuition is reviewed on a yearly basis and therefore subject to change.' IE does NOT label it with an academic year, so the figure applying to a September 2027 intake is NOT YET CONFIRMED.
non_eu_surcharge: NO differential fee found. IE is private and publishes a single tuition figure (36,000€) with no nationality- or residency-based variation anywhere on the admissions & fees page. This is 'no' with evidence, not an assumption — the page was read in full. The page does add a non-EU-specific PROCEDURAL warning, verbatim: 'If you are non-EU candidate, we encourage you to confirm your place and begin your visa process as early as possible. Keep in mind that depending on your region, visa-related deadlines may apply.'
entry_requirements: Bachelor's degree from an accredited university; official university transcripts (certified translation into English or Spanish); English certificate (see above); an admissions test — verbatim: 'Applicants must provide results from the GMAT, GRE, or IE Global Admissions Test (ieGAT)'; the Kira live assessment (three short questions, one written and two video, ~20-30 minutes); application fee 150€ non-refundable. Decision typically 1-3 weeks after a complete application (FAQ elsewhere on the same page says 4-6 weeks on average — minor internal inconsistency, both quoted).
accepts_engineering_background: YES — INFERRED AND SAFE. The stated bar is only 'Bachelor's degree from an accredited university'; no discipline restriction is published, and the programme is explicitly designed to combine computing with business. A Software Engineering degree is comfortably above the stated bar. No named list of accepted degrees exists to quote, hence 'inferred'.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) — ects_complementos_formativos = 0 in the RUCT record for 3500706. No applicant-level complementos rule is published on IE's admissions page; IE screens by admissions test and interview rather than by bridging credits.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND. No reconocimiento de créditos / advanced standing policy is published on the programme or admissions pages. The 300-ECTS question is unanswered for this programme. Note the programme is only 60 ECTS and 11 months, so advanced standing has limited practical value here.
application_window_2027: NO DEADLINE — ROLLING ADMISSIONS. IE states verbatim: 'There is no application deadline, as we operate a rolling admissions process and accept applications throughout the year. However, places are limited and awarded on a first-come, first-served basis, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible. On average, the admissions process takes between 4 and 6 weeks, although timelines may vary depending on each individual application.' The intake month is September (the 2026-2027 Fall intake is stated to start 'September 21st'; the exact September 2027 start date is NOT YET PUBLISHED). Admissions decisions are portable: 'Admissions are valid for the intake you apply to and the following one.'
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — IE's own advice, verbatim: 'If you are non-EU candidate, we encourage you to confirm your place and begin your visa process as early as possible.' Combined with first-come-first-served place allocation, an early-autumn-2026 application is advisable for a September 2027 start.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND (page routes to a contact form / local offices rather than publishing an address)
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS in 11 months (RUCT: 39 obligatorios + 15 optativos + 6 TFM, 0 prácticas). IE description: computing, digital technologies and data-driven strategies combined with the commercial side of the tech industry; hands-on tooling named on the page includes 'N8N, Python, SQL, from data analytics to programming environments'. Project-based 'learning by doing' with corporate partners from day one.
notable_faculty_or_lab: IE School of Science & Technology. Faculty described as 'academics and professionals from leading organizations such as Google, Amazon, Intel, Telefonica, Roche'.
industry_links: Strong and central to the format: corporate partner projects, innovation challenges and tech competitions embedded in the programme.
thesis_or_internship: TFM 6 ECTS (RUCT). 0 ECTS prácticas in the registered plan — industry exposure comes through corporate projects rather than a credited internship.

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Ingeniería y Ciencia de Datos
programme_name_en: University Master's Degree in Engineering and Data Science
institution: Universidad Nacional de Educación a Distancia (UNED)
city: Madrid (seat) — taught fully at a distance
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL). RUCT 4316950, estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA)', MECES 3, RD 1393/2007, verificación 11/04/2019, BOE 03/08/2019 and 19/12/2020, 'Resolución Favorable para la Renov. de la Acreditación (12/12/2024)'.
modality: online / a distancia (UNED virtual platform, non-residential)
language_of_instruction: CASTELLANO — HARD FILTER. Verbatim from the UNED programme page: 'En todas las asignaturas se usará como lengua vehicular el castellano.' English appears only through bibliography and videos of international experts. This programme is NOT accessible to a candidate at Spanish A0/A1 and would require at least B2 by September 2027.
language_requirement: Spanish is the vehicular language of every subject. English is only RECOMMENDED, verbatim: 'Se recomienda que los alumnos del máster tengan el nivel B1' (B1 English). No Spanish certificate requirement is stated, but the teaching language makes B2 Spanish a practical necessity.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — Orden CNU/573/2026, de 4 de junio (BOE-A-2026-12413), Anexo II.2, row 'MÁSTER UNIVERSITARIO EN INGENIERÍA Y CIENCIA DE DATOS', rama Ingeniería y Arquitectura: 31,40 EUR first enrolment (50,70 second, 55,38 third, 58,50 fourth and subsequent).
non_eu_surcharge: NO — AND THIS IS EXPLICIT IN LAW, NOT AN ASSUMPTION. The UNED price order for 2026-27 states verbatim, Segundo.6: 'Los precios públicos aplicables serán los mismos independientemente de la nacionalidad o el país de residencia de los estudiantes.' UNED is therefore the ONLY institution found in this batch with a statutorily nationality-blind fee. A Tunisian non-resident pays the same 31,40 EUR per ECTS as a Spanish resident. THIS IS THE CHEAPEST OFFICIAL MÁSTER UNIVERSITARIO IN THE BATCH BY A LARGE MARGIN.
entry_requirements: A degree in Computer Science / Computer Engineering or related fields; also accepted are graduates in Telecommunications, Industrial Engineering or similar, IT technicians, and graduates in Physics or Mathematics. B1 English recommended. Maximum 75 new places per year. Admission baremo: alignment of prior training (degree and credits) up to 4 points; GPA up to 4 points; other merits (CV, complementary training, languages, other degrees, publications) up to 2 points.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT. Computer Science / Computer Engineering is the first-named accepted profile and scores in the top band of the admission baremo. A Software Engineering degree is directly on target.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) — ects_complementos_formativos = 0 for 4316950, so the TITLE carries no compulsory bridging load. At APPLICANT level, however, UNED publishes six foundational subjects totalling 36 ECTS (programming, advanced data structures, networks, AI, security, statistics, databases) available to students lacking the prerequisite knowledge. A software-engineering graduate should need few or none, but this is an applicant-level assessment the admission committee makes — quoting the programme page, not RUCT.
credit_recognition_available: YES — a general UNED regime exists and is priced in the fee order: the order provides that students obtaining reconocimiento de créditos pay a set charge, and that requests for recognition above four ECTS from studies outside UNED carry a fee. No programme-specific rule on a 300-ECTS entrant was found. So: mechanism confirmed, entitlement NOT FOUND.
application_window_2027: NOT YET PUBLISHED for the 2027-28 (September 2027) intake — the UNED admission page carried no 2027-28 calendar as at 2026-08-25. THE 2026-27 CALENDAR, RECORDED AS SUCH: ordinary preinscripción for new students 'del 17 de mayo al 10 de julio de 2026'; a few masters close early on '2 de junio de 2026' (Cybersecurity, Teacher Training, General Health Psychology — Ingeniería y Ciencia de Datos is NOT among them); Industrial Engineering closes '31 de julio de 2026'. Admission committees resolve by '30 de julio de 2026'. Extraordinary period for programmes with places left: 'del 1 al 10 de septiembre de 2026'. UNED therefore runs a LATE (May-July) window, the opposite of UC3M's December opening.
application_rounds: {"round": "Ordinary preinscripción, new students (2026-27 intake, NOT 2027-28)", "opens": "2026-05-17", "closes": "2026-07-10", "resolution_by": "2026-07-30"} | {"round": "Extraordinary period, programmes with vacancies (2026-27 intake)", "opens": "2026-09-01", "closes": "2026-09-10"}
non_eu_early_round_advised: NOT APPLICABLE IN THE USUAL SENSE — UNED publishes no separate non-EU round and the programme is fully online, so no student visa or relocation is needed to study it. That removes the single biggest timing risk a non-EU applicant faces. However the ordinary window closes 10 July, leaving little slack, and 75 places are allocated on a merit baremo rather than first-come.
admissions_contact_email: infouned@adm.uned.es
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS in one academic year over two quarters (RUCT: 40 ECTS obligatorios + 8 ECTS optativos + 12 ECTS TFM, 0 prácticas). Data engineering and data science delivered entirely through the UNED virtual campus with self-directed study, tutor support and multiple communication channels. RUCT campo de estudio: 'Ingeniería informática y de sistemas'.
notable_faculty_or_lab: UNED Escuela Técnica Superior de Ingeniería Informática. Not verified at individual level.
industry_links: NOT FOUND. 0 ECTS prácticas in the registered plan.
thesis_or_internship: TFM 12 ECTS (RUCT). No credited internship.

programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Bioinformatics and Biomedical Data Analysis
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL). RUCT 4318345, estado 'Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)', MECES 3, RD 1393/2007, verificación 13/03/2023, BOE 27/07/2023 and 04/12/2023, 'Resolución Favorable Acreditacion Institucional (18/06/2026)'. The page also gives the implantation year: 'Curso 2023-2024, conforme a lo establecido en el artículo 25 del R.D. 1393/2007'.
modality: presencial — verbatim 'De octubre a Junio · 60 ECTS · Lunes a Jueves 16:00-21:00h'
language_of_instruction: Castellano — the programme page states 'Idioma: Castellano' in two separate places (the fact bar and the título's data block). HARD FILTER at A0/A1.
language_requirement: TWO CERTIFICATE REQUIREMENTS, BOTH EXPLICIT AND BOTH BINDING ON THIS CANDIDATE. Verbatim: 'Para poder acceder a este Máster, el alumno tendrá que demostrar el dominio de la lengua extranjera de inglés equivalente al nivel B1 del Marco Común Europeo de Referencia para las Lenguas. Para alumnos extranjeros de habla diferente al española tendrán que demostrar el dominio de la lengua castellana equivalente al nivel B2 del Marco Común Europeo de Referencia para las Lenguas.' So: English B1 (easily met) AND certified SPANISH B2 for non-Spanish-speaking foreign students (not met at A0/A1). This is the second programme in the batch with a written Spanish B2 admission requirement, after Universidad de Navarra.
tuition_year_of_rates: Price shown against the 'Próxima edición: Octubre 2026', i.e. the 2026-27 edition. 2027-28 price NOT PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: NO — none published. UFV publishes one 'Total tuition fee' with no extracomunitario/non-resident row on any page checked. The only non-EU-relevant burden is linguistic, not financial: the B2 Spanish requirement.
entry_requirements: Verbatim: 'Constituirá un requisito necesario para el acceso estar en posesión de un título universitario en Ciencias o Ciencias de la Salud. Podrán ser consideradas las candidaturas de alumnos con formación académica en otras áreas o con experiencia profesional contrastada en el campo de la Biomedicina.' Plus English B1 and, for non-Spanish-speaking foreigners, Spanish B2. 40 verified places, and the page warns 'El número de plazas es limitado debido al carácter práctico y personalizado de la formación. Te recomendamos iniciar el proceso de admisión lo antes posible.'
accepts_engineering_background: NO — NOT AS OF RIGHT, AND THIS IS EXPLICIT. The necessary requirement is a degree in CIENCIAS or CIENCIAS DE LA SALUD. Engineering is not among them. A software engineer can only be considered under the discretionary clause for 'alumnos con formación académica en otras áreas o con experiencia profesional contrastada en el campo de la Biomedicina' — and this candidate has no biomedicine experience. Treat admission as unlikely without a biomedical track record. This is the one programme in the batch where the candidate's degree is a genuine obstacle rather than an asset.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) — ects_complementos_formativos = 0 for 4318345. BUT THE PLAN ITSELF CARRIES A 'Complementos Formativos' BLOCK at applicant level, containing optional bridging subjects such as 'Fundamentos de Genética' (OP, 1st semester). A non-biology entrant should expect to be assigned some of these. Quoting the programme's plan de estudios, not RUCT.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND. No reconocimiento de créditos statement located on the programme page (the page links a 'Normativas' section not opened in this pass). The 300-ECTS question is unanswered.
application_window_2027: NO DATED APPLICATION WINDOW — UFV runs ROLLING admission. Its postgraduate admissions page states 'Proceso de admisión abierto curso 2026' with a four-step flow (Inscríbete → Reserva plaza → …) and no opening or closing date; the programme page adds verbatim 'Places are limited due to the practical and personalised nature of the programme. The only date UFV publishes is an ENROLMENT (not application) deadline for already-admitted students, on its 2026-27 banner: 'Si has sido admitido en la UFV, ya puedes realizar tu matrícula antes del 31 de julio' (i.e. 31 July 2026 for the 2026-27 intake). 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED; the above is marked as 2026-27 and has NOT been shifted forward. The programme's own calendar for the current edition is stated verbatim as 'Calendario: Octubre 2026 – Junio 2027'.
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES by implication — the university's own advice is to start admission as early as possible because places are limited. No separate non-EU round is published.

curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS from October to June, weekday evenings Monday to Thursday 16:00-21:00 (RUCT: 42 ECTS obligatorios + 12 ECTS prácticas + 6 ECTS TFM, 0 optativos). Management and analysis of large biomedical datasets for personalised medicine, diagnosis, prevention and therapy development. RUCT rama: Ciencias; the title's own data block gives ámbito de conocimiento 'Ciencias de la Computación'. A 'Complementos Formativos' block sits alongside the core plan.

programme_name_en: Master in Data Science
institution: CONJUNTO: Universidad Internacional Menéndez Pelayo (UIMP) + Universidad de Cantabria (UC); taught with CSIC / Instituto de Física de Cantabria involvement
modality: presencial
language_of_instruction: Castellano (algún seminario podría darse en inglés)
language_requirement: B2 English required (accredited); teaching itself is in Castellano — SPANISH-LANGUAGE FILTER for this candidate
non_eu_surcharge: NO — and this was checked positively, not assumed. UIMP DOES operate differentiated non-EU pricing, but only for a NAMED SUBSET of its masters: its BOE price resolution (Resolución de 24 de marzo de 2025, BOE-A-2025-7584) tags certain titles 'Máster con precio diferenciado para los estudiantes extranjeros no residentes en el Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior (EEES)' and doubles the rate for them (e.g. the Economics and Finance master charges non-EEES students 110 EUR/credit vs 55 EUR/credit — exactly double). The tagged list comprises Economía y Finanzas, Plásticos y Caucho, Biodiversidad Tropical, Biología Sintética, Tecnologías Cuánticas and Liderazgo Público — CIENCIA DE DATOS IS NOT AMONG THEM, and its own 2026-27 ficha shows a single 26.35 EUR/credit figure with no second rate. ⚠️ This is exactly the trap the brief warns about in reverse: the surcharge is real at this university but does not apply to this title, so quoting a doubled figure here would be wrong.
entry_requirements: Direct admission for graduates in Mathematics, Physics or Computer Science/Ingeniería Informática with 240+ credits (admitted without complementos). Graduates of other engineerings or of Economics need a minimum of 24 credits of mathematics (including statistics) and 12 credits of informatics (including programming).
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT — Ingeniería Informática is named among the degrees admitted directly without complementos de formación; other engineerings are admitted subject to the 24-maths / 12-informatics credit floor.
complementary_credits_required: TWO ANSWERS, and here they diverge sharply. (a) FOR THE TITLE, from RUCT: 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' is NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (null in the register extract — NOT the same as 0). (b) FOR THE APPLICANT, from the UIMP ficha: complementos ARE real and can be large — UP TO 30 ECTS, split as 18 ECTS of mathematics and 12 ECTS of computing, imposed on applicants whose background lacks that grounding. BUT the ficha also states the exemption directly: the master is aimed especially at holders of a 240-credit degree in Matemáticas, Física or Ingeniería Informática, 'quienes serán admitidos sin necesidad de formación adicional' — i.e. admitted with NO complementos. A 300-ECTS Software Engineering degree sits inside that exempt group (as an Ingeniería Informática equivalent), so the expected complementos load for this candidate is 0 — but that is my reading of the exemption clause, and the Comisión Académica decides per file, so it should be confirmed in writing. NOT FOUND: any published advanced-standing / reconocimiento de créditos rule that would credit the extra 60 ECTS.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND as a reconocimiento-de-créditos rule, but the entry rule is credit-based (24 maths / 12 informatics), so a 300-ECTS software engineering degree should clear it comfortably and avoid complementos. That inference is the applicant-level consequence of the published rule, not a separate published exemption.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED. Full 2026-27 calendar (marked 2026-27, NOT shifted forward), verbatim from the UIMP ficha for curso 2026-27 — note this intake starts 1 October 2026 and runs to 30 September 2027 (X Edición): ORDINARIO — preinscripción 'del 9 de marzo al 29 de mayo de 2026 (hasta las 23:59 hora peninsular española)'; lista provisional de admitidos 'hasta el 15 de junio de 2026'; reclamaciones 'en los dos días hábiles siguientes'; admisión definitiva 'al día siguiente de finalizar el periodo de reclamación'; matrícula 'A partir del 24 de junio de 2026, en los 10 días naturales a contar desde la recepción del correo electrónico'. EXTRAORDINARIO — preinscripción 'del 14 de julio al 11 de septiembre de 2026'; lista provisional 'hasta el 21 de septiembre de 2026'. No separate non-EU early round is published; a non-EU applicant needing a visa should target the ORDINARIO round, since the extraordinario closes only three weeks before teaching starts.
non_eu_early_round_advised: NOT FOUND — no separate international round published; 25 places only.
admissions_contact_email: info-masterdatascience@listas.csic.es (academic); alumnos.posgrado@uimp.es (administrative)
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS = 36 obligatorios + 18 optativos + 6 TFM (RUCT breakdown). Classes Monday–Friday 15:30–19:30 in Santander over the 2026-27 course.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Academic coordinators Francisco Matorras (UC) and Lara Lloret (UIMP); run with CSIC / Instituto de Física de Cantabria — a strong physics-and-data research environment.

NEEDS A HUMAN TO OPEN IT IN A NORMAL BROWSER. ⚠️ LIVE RISK: Decreto 98/2023 art. 3.2 EXPRESSLY PERMITS Andalusian universities to raise prices for non-EU non-resident students by up to 100% of the cost of the service. Andalucía is therefore one of the communities the brief warns about, where the decree authorises rather than fixes the non-EU price — so the real figure must come from UJA's own tariff, and UJA's own tariff page is the one that is down. The decree text itself contains no non-EU price. Current best answer: no surcharge levied by UJA, sourced from the search index only.

tuition_year_of_rates: Anexo I of Decreto 98/2023 applies 'a partir del curso académico 2023-2024' and stays in force 'en tanto no se aprueben nuevos precios públicos' (Disp. final primera, consolidated text 15/09/2025) — i.e. these are the rates currently in force and were unchanged for 2025-26. 2027-28 rates NOT YET PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: CONDITIONAL — and the condition is favourable to this candidate. Decreto 98/2023 art. 3.2 does NOT fix a non-EU price: 'El estudiantado extranjero mencionado en el apartado 1 que no sea residente en España abonará los precios ... previstos en este decreto. No obstante, las universidades en que se matricule podrán establecer una variación en el precio de los créditos en cualquier nivel de estudios, sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del 100% del coste del servicio académico'. Andalucía therefore behaves like Cataluña/Asturias — the real figure is on the UNIVERSITY's tariff. UMA's own máster tariff annex resolves it: the ordinary rates apply provisionally to foreign nationals over 18 who hold neither residency NOR 'la autorización de estancia por estudios' — i.e. a student stay authorisation is EXPRESSLY sufficient to keep the ordinary rate at UMA (unlike Catalonia's Decret, where a long-stay study authorisation explicitly does not equal residency). Proof must be filed at the Centre's Secretaría before 1 November; otherwise UMA issues 'una liquidación complementaria que podrá alcanzar el 100% del coste real de la prestación de los citados servicios'. CAVEAT: the tariff annex read carries the 2023/24 heading; the residency clause is standard UMA boilerplate but the 2027-28 wording is unverified.
entry_requirements: Access per the Distrito Único Andaluz rules. Holders of foreign (non-EHEA) degrees may enter WITHOUT homologación: 'los titulados de sistemas educativos extranjeros ... podrán acceder a este Máster sin necesidad de la homologación de sus títulos, previa comprobación de que acreditan un nivel de formación equivalente a los correspondientes títulos españoles y que facultan en el país expedidor del título para el acceso a estudios de posgrado'. Where demand exceeds places, selection weighs prior academic training, professional experience, a possible (remote) interview, and real availability for the in-person sessions.

A Software Engineering degree is NOT named on that list — it is an engineering degree but not one of the enumerated profiles, so admission is plausible but NOT explicitly guaranteed. Flag as INFERRED for this specific background.

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Gestión Forestal basada en Ciencia de Datos (DATAFOREST)
programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Forest Management based on Data Science (DATAFOREST)
city: Palencia — E.T.S. de Ingenierías Agrarias, Campus de Palencia
modality: presencial (3 semesters). A part-time route at 30 ECTS/year with roughly one and a half days of class per week is offered.
language_of_instruction: 'Español, Inglés' — verbatim from the UVa official plan record. Genuinely bilingual, not an artefact of an English webpage: UVa's Relaciones Internacionales publishes a full 30-ECTS semester delivered entirely in English within this master. Spanish is nonetheless used for part of the teaching, so this is NOT an English-only programme.
language_requirement: English B1 (CEFR) required for admission; B2 recommended. No Spanish certificate requirement published — but given the plan is Spanish/English, functional Spanish is realistically needed.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 (Decreto 8/2024 de 30 de mayo, BOCyL 3/06/2024, set for 2024-25 and prorrogado to 2025-26; Disposición final primera auto-extends where no new decree is approved). 2027-28 rates NOT YET PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: NO — verified by reading the decree, not by silence on a programme page. Decreto 8/2024 contains NO article on estudiantes extranjeros / no comunitarios / no residentes en España, and no clause delegating a non-EU price to the universities. One scale applies to everyone in Castilla y León. This is the mechanism to note: CyL differs from Madrid/La Rioja/Valencia (distinct published non-EU tariff) AND from Cataluña/Asturias/Andalucía (decree authorises the university to charge up to 100% of cost).
entry_requirements: Official university degree or EHEA-equivalent. Priority to graduates in forestry / natural resources OR INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY fields. Perfil de ingreso: 'titulados (graduados, ingenieros, licenciados o ingenieros técnicos) del ámbito técnico con formación en métodos de análisis de datos relacionados con la gestión del medio natural'. English B1 required. 20 places.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT. The access rules name Information Technology degrees (Informática, Estadística) as a priority entry route alongside the forestry ones, and the master is deliberately designed to take both intakes. A Software Engineering graduate enters via the IT route.
complementary_credits_required: FOR THE TITLE: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (the 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' row is absent for 4316066). FOR THE APPLICANT: the UVa programme page's admission section requires only 'un Título Universitario oficial' (or EHEA equivalent) plus English at 'nivel B1 del Marco Común Europeo', and lists a points-based merit scale (affinity of degree up to 3, marks up to 3, languages up to 2, exchanges up to 1, professional experience up to 1) — no complementos de formación are stated. Note Decreto 8/2024 art. 3.2 confirms that where a UVa master does impose complementos they are charged at the same per-credit rate.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND for a 300-ECTS entrant. No reconocimiento de créditos rule specific to this title was published. Structurally there is unusual headroom compared with the other programmes in this batch — RUCT records 33 ECTS of optativos out of 90 — but nothing states that prior study can be recognised against them.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED. UVa's published calendar for 2026-27 (all deadlines close 13:00 on the last day): 1st period preinscripción 2 February – 8 April 2026, admitted list 16 April, enrolment 17–21 April 2026; 2nd period 17 April – 9 July 2026, list 20 July, enrolment 21–27 July 2026; 3rd period 21 July – 31 August 2026, list 10 September, enrolment 11–15 September 2026.
application_rounds: 2026-27 1st period: 2 Feb – 8 Apr 2026 | 2026-27 2nd period: 17 Apr – 9 Jul 2026 | 2026-27 3rd period: 21 Jul – 31 Aug 2026
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — procedural, not a separate window. A holder of a non-EHEA unhomologated degree must file a 'Solicitud de Comprobación de Estudios' as a prerequisite to preinscripción, with an official transcript covering at least 6 semesters, a university certificate confirming the degree grants master access in the issuing country, and a sworn Spanish translation; at enrolment the degree must be legalised through diplomatic channels. Apply in the 1st period (opens early February).
admissions_contact_email: master.gestion.forestal@uva.es
curriculum_summary: 90 ECTS over 3 semesters: 39 obligatorios + 33 optativos + 6 prácticas + 12 TFM (RUCT). Data science applied to forest inventory, remote sensing and natural-resource management. A double-degree route exists with AgroParisTech (Master Agrosciences, Environnement, Territoires, Paysage, Forêts, specialisation 'Forest and their environment'). RELEVANCE WARNING: the data science here is domain-specific to forestry/geospatial work. It is a real data science master by method but its career surface is environmental, not audio, AI or general analytics — a weak fit for this candidate's stated targets despite the AB tag.
notable_faculty_or_lab: iuFOR (Instituto Universitario de Investigación en Gestión Forestal Sostenible, UVa–INIA) collaborates in the programme; E.T.S. de Ingenierías Agrarias, Palencia.
industry_links: 6 ECTS prácticas in the RUCT structure; those with a forestry background take 3 credits of R&D practice as the alternative to the bridging course.
thesis_or_internship: Both: prácticas 6 ECTS + Trabajo Fin de Máster 12 ECTS.

modality: presencial with distance-learning support — 'se imparte de forma presencial, con el apoyo de herramientas de enseñanza a distancia (Moodle, Teams, etc.)'
language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND. No 'idiomas de impartición' statement appears on the UDC estudos pages for plan 4539v01 (start, detail or admission). The programme is hosted by the Facultade de Dereito, is titled and described in Spanish and Galician only, and Galician-system law masters are normally taught in castellano and/or galego. Treat as Spanish/Galician and NOT English — but this is UNCONFIRMED and must not be recorded as a verified value.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND
tuition_year_of_rates: Ordinary rates 2025/26 (Decreto 55/2025, DOG 130 de 9/07/2025) and unchanged in 2026/27 (Decreto 72/2026, DOG 127 de 9/07/2026). Non-resident rate from UDC's rectoral resolution — figure verified in the 2022/23 text; 2026/27 resolution exists (2 July 2026) but its text was not retrievable. 2027-28 NOT YET PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — +25%, AND THE EXEMPTION LIST EXCLUDES TUNISIA. Two-step mechanism, as the brief predicts for Galicia. (1) Decreto 55/2025 / Decreto 72/2026 art. 2.5 fixes NO non-EU price: 'La universidad establecerá, mediante resolución rectoral debidamente motivada, los precios a abonar por la matrícula en estudios de grado y máster por el alumnado extranjero mayor de dieciocho años que no tenga la condición de residente', excluding EU nationals and those under the régimen comunitario, with the resolution capped at the previous year's rates. (2) The universities of the Sistema Universitario de Galicia agreed the price jointly at '25 % del coste de referencia para cada uno de los epígrafes de la tarifa primera', which in practice lands at EXACTLY 125% of the ordinary per-credit price: UDC's resolution sets 17,41 EUR/crédito for epígrafe A and 12,31 EUR/crédito for epígrafe B against ordinary 13,93 and 9,85 — i.e. a flat +25% surcharge. Universidade de Vigo states the same rule in plain terms: non-resident non-EU students over 18 pay academic fees 'increased by 25%'. (3) THE EXEMPTION: the resolution carries an ANEXO of 'países con índice de desarrollo humano (IDH) medio y bajo' whose nationals pay the ORDINARY decree prices. MOROCCO IS ON THAT LIST. TUNISIA IS NOT (nor is any other Maghreb state except Morocco). Tunisia is classed High HDI, so this candidate pays the +25% rate. PROVENANCE CAVEAT: the 17,41 / 12,31 figures and the country annex are read from UDC's resolution for 2022/23, the most recent full text obtainable — the 2025/26 resolution (30 June 2025) and the 2026/27 one (2 July 2026) exist and are announced by UDC but their texts sit behind sede.udc.gal document links that were not retrievable. The ordinary rates have been frozen at 13,93 / 9,85 across 2022/23–2026/27 and both decrees cap the resolution at the prior year's level, so the figures are almost certainly unchanged — but a human should open the current resolution to confirm, and to confirm Tunisia's continued absence from the annex.
entry_requirements: 'Para acceder a las enseñanzas oficiales de máster será necesario estar en posesión de un título universitario oficial' or an EHEA equivalent granting master access. 25 places. Coordinator Natalia Álvarez Lata, Facultade de Dereito.
accepts_engineering_background: NOT FOUND — and doubtful. No perfil de ingreso recomendado is published on the UDC pages for this title. RUCT classifies it under rama 'Ciencias Sociales y Jurídicas', campo de estudio 'Derecho y especialidades jurídicas', and it sits in a law faculty. Nothing states that an engineering degree is accepted; nothing states it is excluded either. This must be treated as UNVERIFIED, not inferred either way.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) — ects_complementos_formativos = 0 in the register. No applicant-level complementos statement was found on the UDC admission page.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND. No reconocimiento de créditos rule for this title was published. Structure leaves almost no room anyway: 45 obligatorios + 3 optativos + 6 prácticas + 6 TFM.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED, and the 2026-27 dates could NOT BE READ: UDC publishes its master admission calendar as embedded images on the plazos page, which returns no machine-readable dates. What IS confirmed: UDC runs THREE admission rounds — plazo ANTICIPADO (capped at '50% del total de las plazas ofertadas'), plazo ORDINARIO and plazo EXTRAORDINARIO, all closing at 23:59 peninsular time on the last day. Periods are approved by the UDC Consejo de Gobierno. FLAG FOR HUMAN: open https://www.udc.gal/es/futuros_estudantes/masteres/prazos-e-datas-de-admision/ in a browser to read the dates off the images.
application_rounds: Plazo anticipado (max 50% of places) | Plazo ordinario | Plazo extraordinario
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — UDC's plazo anticipado exists precisely to let applicants settle admission early, and half the places are available in it. Exact dates not readable (see application_window_2027). No separate international-only procedure was documented.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND — coordinator named (Natalia Álvarez Lata) but no email published on the pages opened.
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS over two semesters: 45 obligatorios + 3 optativos + 6 prácticas externas + 6 TFM (RUCT). Covers data protection, public and private contracting, cybercrime, international security, robotics, artificial intelligence, IoT and drones, combining theory and practice. RELEVANCE WARNING: this is a LAW master about AI, not a technical AI master. Despite the AA tag it teaches no machine learning and would not build the candidate's engineering profile. Recorded for completeness; a poor fit for the stated targets.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Facultade de Dereito, UDC. Coordinator Natalia Álvarez Lata.
industry_links: 6 ECTS prácticas externas.
thesis_or_internship: Both: prácticas externas 6 ECTS + TFM 6 ECTS.

programme_name_en: Master's Degree in High Performance Computing
institution: Universidade da Coruña (UDC, coordinating) + Universidade de Santiago de Compostela (USC), organised together with CESGA (Centro de Supercomputación de Galicia)
city: A Coruña (Facultade de Informática, UDC) and Santiago de Compostela (ETSE, USC)
modality: CONFLICT / CHANGED. USC's current catalogue entry is explicitly ONLINE and requires students to sign a declaration that they own or can access adequate computing equipment and maintain connectivity. Older programme documentation describes it as presencial with theory classes delivered by videoconference between the master classroom at USC and the master classroom at UDC. A part-time route at 30 ECTS/year over two years is available.
language_of_instruction: 'Spanish, Galician, English' — verbatim from the USC official catalogue entry. Trilingual. This is one of the few programmes in this batch where English is genuinely declared in the official record rather than inferred from an English webpage.
language_requirement: English B1 (CEFR) — 'Será necesario acreditar unos conocimientos mínimos de inglés correspondientes al nivel B1 del marco común europeo de referencia'. USC states it can be evidenced after enrolment; UDC's admission page states it must be demonstrated before completing the programme, not for entry. No Spanish or Galician certificate requirement published.
tuition_year_of_rates: Ordinary rates 2025/26 (Decreto 55/2025, DOG 130 de 9/07/2025), unchanged for 2026/27 (Decreto 72/2026, DOG 127 de 9/07/2026). Non-resident rate verified in UDC's 2022/23 rectoral resolution; the 2026/27 resolution (2 July 2026) exists but its text was not retrievable. 2027-28 NOT YET PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — +25%, AND THE EXEMPTION LIST EXCLUDES TUNISIA. Two-step mechanism. (1) Decreto 55/2025 / Decreto 72/2026 art. 2.5 fixes NO non-EU price: 'La universidad establecerá, mediante resolución rectoral debidamente motivada, los precios a abonar por la matrícula en estudios de grado y máster por el alumnado extranjero mayor de dieciocho años que no tenga la condición de residente', excluding EU nationals and the régimen comunitario, capped at the previous year's rates. (2) The Sistema Universitario de Galicia universities agreed the price jointly at '25 % del coste de referencia para cada uno de los epígrafes de la tarifa primera', which lands at exactly 125% of the ordinary price: UDC's resolution sets 17,41 EUR/crédito for epígrafe A (against ordinary 13,93) and 12,31 for epígrafe B (against 9,85). Universidade de Vigo states the same rule plainly: non-resident non-EU students over 18 pay academic fees 'increased by 25%'. (3) THE EXEMPTION: an ANEXO lists 'países con índice de desarrollo humano (IDH) medio y bajo' whose nationals pay ORDINARY prices. MOROCCO IS ON IT; TUNISIA IS NOT. So this candidate pays +25%. JOINT-TITLE NOTE: the title is awarded by UDC and USC together. UDC coordinates, but a student enrolling through USC falls under USC's own separate rectoral resolution rather than UDC's — the SUG-wide 25% agreement should make them identical, but that was not verified against the USC text. PROVENANCE CAVEAT: figures and country annex read from UDC's 2022/23 resolution, the most recent retrievable full text; the 2025/26 (30 June 2025) and 2026/27 (2 July 2026) resolutions exist and are announced by UDC but sit behind sede.udc.gal document links that could not be fetched. Ordinary rates have been frozen at 13,93 / 9,85 across 2022/23–2026/27 and both decrees cap the resolution at the prior year, so the figures are very likely unchanged — a human should confirm, and re-check Tunisia's absence from the annex.
entry_requirements: Official university degree or EHEA equivalent granting master access. Recommended profile names degrees in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics, Industrial Engineering, Physics, Mathematics 'or related Science/Engineering fields'. Admission criteria (UDC): 'Los criterios de admisión se basarán en la adecuación del expediente académico a los contenidos del máster (criterio excluyente) y el expediente académico' — subject-matter fit is an EXCLUDING criterion, then the academic record ranks. B1 English. VERY FEW PLACES: 13 at UDC + 4 at USC.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT and squarely on target. 'Computer Science' heads the recommended entry list. A Software Engineering degree satisfies the excluding 'adecuación del expediente académico' criterion directly; ranking then turns on marks. The binding constraint here is places (17 in total across both universities), not eligibility.
complementary_credits_required: FOR THE TITLE: 0 (RUCT) — the RUCT detail page for 4316445 publishes 'Complementos Formativos: 0'. FOR THE APPLICANT: no complementos are imposed; instead the programme sets substantive entry prerequisites on its admission page — a bachelor's in engineering (computing, telecommunications) or applied sciences (mathematics, physics, biology), competence in 'alguno o varios de los siguientes lenguajes de programación: Java, C++, C o Fortran', basic Linux, and English B1 (certified before completing the degree, not required at admission). Selection is on academic record and CV by the Comisión Académica. A 300-ECTS software-engineering graduate meets the stated profile directly.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND. No reconocimiento de créditos rule published for this title. The 60 ECTS run as 11 taught subjects across two semesters plus TFM.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED, and the 2026-27 dates could NOT BE READ: UDC publishes the master admission calendar as embedded images that return no machine-readable text. Confirmed structure: THREE rounds — plazo ANTICIPADO (capped at '50% del total de las plazas ofertadas'), plazo ORDINARIO, plazo EXTRAORDINARIO, each closing 23:59 peninsular time on the last day, approved by the UDC Consejo de Gobierno. city: San Sebastián / Donostia. NOTE THE GEOGRAPHY TRAP: the university is called 'de Navarra' but Tecnun's campus is in Gipuzkoa, in the BASQUE COUNTRY, not in Navarre. autonomous_community: País Vasco (campus). The awarding university is headquartered in Comunidad Foral de Navarra.
modality: 'Presencial - Full time', 9 months
language_of_instruction: 'Castellano e Inglés' — verbatim from the Universidad de Navarra programme page. Genuinely bilingual; Spanish is part of the declared teaching language, so this is NOT an English-only route.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND — no certificate level published on the programme or Tecnun admission pages.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 (published by Universidad de Navarra as the master tuition table for curso 2026-2027). 2027-28 NOT YET PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: NO — none found, and none expected. Universidad de Navarra is a PRIVATE university: it sets a single tuition figure per programme and no decreto de precios públicos applies. The published 2026-27 master price table lists one fee per programme with no nationality or residency column, and neither the programme page nor the Tecnun admission page mentions a differentiated international rate. Recorded as 'no differentiated non-EU price found on the published tariff' rather than a positive guarantee — the pages are silent rather than explicit. Note also that the scholarship framing cuts the other way for once: Tecnun states its HAAS Talent scholarships are 'dirigidas a estudiantes de cualquier procedencia geográfica', i.e. explicitly open to international applicants.
entry_requirements: NOT FOUND in detail. Neither the programme page nor Tecnun's máster admission page publishes degree requirements, foreign-credential validation procedure or language requirements. Admission runs through the miUNAV portal in three convocatorias. 40 places.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — INFERRED FROM THE TITLE AND SCHOOL, NOT FROM A PUBLISHED RULE. The programme is 'Análisis de Datos EN INGENIERÍA', taught by Tecnun (Escuela de Ingeniería), RUCT rama 'Ingeniería y Arquitectura', and its stated purpose is data projects 'en entornos tecnológicos, empresariales e industriales'. An engineering intake is plainly the design assumption. But no perfil de ingreso or list of accepted degrees was published on the pages opened, so this is inference — label it as such.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) — ects_complementos_formativos = 0 in the register, verified from output/ruct-detail.jsonl. No applicant-level complementos statement was published, so a university-imposed requirement at admission cannot be excluded.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND. No reconocimiento de créditos rule was published for this title. RUCT structure: 30 obligatorios + 15 optativos + 15 TFM, no prácticas — the 15 optative credits are the only obvious surface for recognition.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED. Tecnun's published ordinary calendar (the 2025/26 cycle, which is the pattern to expect) runs THREE convocatorias and OPENS THE AUTUMN BEFORE THE INTAKE: 1ª convocatoria application deadline 28 November 2024, place reservation 18 December 2024; 2ª convocatoria application 7 February 2025, reservation 28 February 2025; 3ª convocatoria application 16 May 2025, reservation 6 June 2025. Applications are made through the miUNAV portal. For a September 2027 start, expect the first convocatoria to close around late NOVEMBER 2026 — the earliest deadline of any programme in this batch.
application_rounds: 1ª convocatoria: application late November, place reservation mid-December (2025/26 cycle: 28 Nov / 18 Dec 2024) | 2ª convocatoria: application early February, reservation end February (2025/26 cycle: 7 Feb / 28 Feb 2025) | 3ª convocatoria: application mid-May, reservation early June (2025/26 cycle: 16 May / 6 Jun 2025)
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — and this is the earliest-closing programme in the batch by a wide margin. The first convocatoria closes in NOVEMBER, roughly ten months before the September intake, and each convocatoria is followed within about three weeks by a binding place-reservation payment. A non-EU applicant who waits for the May round is competing for whatever remains of 40 places and has a compressed visa timeline. Budget for the reservation payment: a place reservation of 3.000 EUR is reported for this master (deducted later from tuition), which must be found months before any scholarship is confirmed — a real cash-flow obstacle.
admissions_contact_email: smontestallon@tecnun.es
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS over 9 months: 30 obligatorios + 15 optativos + 15 TFM (RUCT), no prácticas externas credited. Advanced multidisciplinary training in the techniques and tools for data management, analysis and exploitation projects in technological, business and industrial settings. Industrial/engineering data science rather than general ML research — a good fit for path AB, weaker for AA.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Tecnun, Escuela de Ingeniería, Universidad de Navarra, San Sebastián.
industry_links: Framed around industrial and business data projects, but RUCT records 0 ECTS of prácticas externas — no credited placement.
thesis_or_internship: Trabajo Fin de Máster 15 ECTS. No internship.
scholarships_internal: HAAS Talent Scholarships — 10% to 50% of tuition, expressly 'dirigidas a estudiantes de cualquier procedencia geográfica' (open to any nationality): https://tecnun.unav.edu/admision-y-ayudas/admision-masteres | Mobility scholarships — up to 400 EUR/month for 10 months of the academic year (i.e. up to 4.000 EUR) | Alumni of Universidad de Navarra: 12% reduction (not applicable to this candidate) | Early payment discount: 5% (terms pending confirmation)

programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Business Intelligence
city: Valencia (registered seat) — delivery is 100% online via the VIU Virtual Campus
modality: online — 100% online with live classes plus recorded content available on demand. Recently verified title: RUCT fecha de verificación 21/10/2024, BOE 01/10/2025, under RD 822/2021. The October 2026 intake is only the SECOND edition.
language_of_instruction: Spanish. Stated as the language of instruction on VIU's own programme page. NOTE THE TRAP: the programme is widely marketed under the English name 'Business Intelligence' and appears in aggregator listings as 'Business Intelligence on-line', which invites the wrong inference. The official plan is Spanish. SPANISH-ONLY — a hard filter for a candidate at A0/A1.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND — no certificate requirement published. In practice a Spanish-medium online master requires working Spanish for live classes.
tuition_year_of_rates: NOT FOUND
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — and not expected. VIU is a private university, so no Valencian decreto de precios públicos applies and no nationality-based tariff was found. Nothing on the programme page distinguishes international from domestic applicants on price. Recorded as NOT FOUND rather than 'no', because the tuition figure itself could not be obtained (see notes).
entry_requirements: Applicants must meet AT LEAST ONE of three routes: (1) a degree in Business, Marketing, Market Research, Finance or Economics with a minimum of 18 ECTS in quantitative techniques and 3 ECTS in programming and algorithms; (2) a degree in ENGINEERING, Statistics or Mathematics — but with complementary courses in Marketing and Business Administration required; (3) professionals with a minimum of two years of demonstrable experience in related areas.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT. 'Ingeniería' is named as one of the three qualifying access routes. But it is the route that carries a bridging obligation (see complementary_credits_required), unlike the business/economics route.
complementary_credits_required: 0 in RUCT — BUT THE RUCT ZERO IS MISLEADING HERE, AND THIS IS EXACTLY THE CASE THE BRIEF WARNS ABOUT. The register records ects_complementos_formativos = 0, meaning the TITLE carries no compulsory bridging credits. At APPLICANT level VIU imposes them by background, and an engineering entrant is precisely the profile that triggers them: a candidate entering via the Engineering/Statistics/Mathematics route 'must complete complementary courses in Marketing and Business Administration'. VIU publishes a menu of four 6-ECTS complementos — Fundamentos del Marketing (6 ECTS), Fundamentos de Administración y Dirección de Empresas (6 ECTS), Métodos cuantitativos (6 ECTS), Bases de datos, algoritmos y programación (6 ECTS). A software engineer would be assigned the two business ones (12 ECTS) and exempted from the two quantitative/programming ones. COST CONSEQUENCE: 12 extra ECTS on top of the 60, almost certainly charged at the same per-credit rate, i.e. roughly a 20% increase in both cost and workload. The exact assignment must be confirmed with VIU admissions.
credit_recognition_available: PARTIALLY ANSWERED, AND IN A USEFUL DIRECTION. VIU does not publish a reconocimiento de créditos rule for a 300-ECTS entrant. However, the complementos menu itself functions as a de facto recognition test: 'Métodos cuantitativos' and 'Bases de datos, algoritmos y programación' are the complementos a non-technical applicant would take, and a 300-ECTS Software Engineering graduate should be exempt from both on prior study. That is an inference from the structure, NOT a published rule — confirm with admissions.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. The page advertises an 'Oct. 2026' intake for curso 2026-27 ('Convocatoria octubre 26/27') with 'PLAZAS LIMITADAS'; VIU publishes the academic calendar PDF for that convocatoria but publishes NO application open/close dates — admission is a rolling 'Solicita admisión' form. The only dated deadlines on the page are commercial: 'Financiación a 36 meses sin intereses | Hasta el 28 de agosto'. Not shifted forward.
application_rounds: Rolling admission against the October intake; no published rounds. Early-bird discount deadline 28 August 2026 for the October 2026 edition.
non_eu_early_round_advised: NO SEPARATE ROUND EXISTS, and for once it barely matters: the programme is 100% ONLINE, so there is no student visa to obtain and no relocation to schedule. THIS IS THE ONE PROGRAMME IN THE BATCH THAT COULD BE STARTED FROM TUNISIA. The trade-off is that it is Spanish-taught and confers no residence in Spain.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND — VIU publishes a phone number (960 01 01 70) and web enquiry forms rather than an admissions mailbox.
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS: 48 obligatorios + 6 prácticas externas + 6 TFM, no optatives (RUCT). Business intelligence: turning data into decision-support for firms. Notably, industry certifications are built into the curriculum — AI-900, PL-300, AB-730 and AB-731 (Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals and Power BI Data Analyst among them), which is unusual for an official Spanish master and gives it a vocational, tooling-led character rather than a research one.
notable_faculty_or_lab: NOT FOUND. VIU Virtual Campus (described as a four-time Catalyst Awards winner).
industry_links: 6 ECTS of prácticas externas académicas are included, plus the embedded Microsoft certification track (AI-900, PL-300, AB-730, AB-731).
thesis_or_internship: Both: prácticas externas 6 ECTS + TFM 6 ECTS.

ects: 60 over one academic year, split into two cuatrimestres. Verbatim module breakdown from the centre's own plan de estudios: "Formación básica (común a los tres itinerarios) 12 · Módulo obligatorio de cada Itinerario 24 · Módulo optativo de cada Itinerario 12 · Prácticas externas 2 · Trabajo fin de Máster 10 · TOTAL 60". Three itinerarios: Creación, Interpretación, Investigación.
modality: presencial — every single asignatura in the official plan de estudios is listed with "Modalidad: Presencial", including Prácticas externas and Trabajo fin de Máster. Full-time and part-time enrolment modes exist ("Matrícula a tiempo completo (60 ECTS)" and a part-time option) but both are presencial.
language_of_instruction: Castellano/Español + Galego, with English added in some subjects. Verbatim from the "Idiomas" field printed in each guía docente of this máster: most subjects read "Idiomas: Castellano, gallego" (or "Castelán, Galego" / "Español y gallego" / "Gallego/Castellano"); ten subjects read "Castellano, galego, inglés" or "Inglés, castellano, gallego"; one reads "Gallego" alone. No subject is taught in English only. ⚠ Galician is a co-language of instruction throughout, not an optional extra.
tuition_total_eur: ~567 EUR for the full 60-ECTS programme (1ª matrícula). Arithmetic: 60 ECTS x 7,80 EUR/ECTS (first enrolment) = 468, plus proba de acceso 64 + apertura de expediente 22 + servizos xerais 13 = 567. Only the proba de acceso figure is confirmed on the centre's own document, verbatim: "PROBA DE ACCESO ... Máster en Creación, Interpretación e Investigación ... 64 €", citing "Normativa: Decreto 89/2013 do 13 de xuño, DOG do 17-06-2013". The per-credit and administrative figures (7,80 EUR/ECTS first enrolment; 11,50 EUR/ECTS second and subsequent; 22 EUR expediente; 13 EUR servizos xerais; 1 EUR/ECTS credit recognition) come from Decreto 163/2024, do 24 de xuño, which modifies Decreto 89/2013, read via the Xunta's consolidated-law portal lex.gal — I did NOT read the DOG original, so treat the per-credit figure as one-source. Bonificacións/exencións apply to familia numerosa, disability >=33%, terrorism and gender-violence victims, and teaching civil servants.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2024-25 onward — Decreto 163/2024 states it applies from the 2024/25 academic year, with a transitional provision covering enrolments begun before entry into force. No later modifying decree found as of 2026-08-25, so these are the rates in force for 2026-27, but no decree explicitly stamped "2026-27" was located for enseñanzas artísticas superiores. NOTE the negative check: Galicia's DECRETO 72/2026, do 29 de xuño (DOG 127, 9/7/2026) fixes 2026/27 prices for the public UNIVERSITIES of the Sistema universitario de Galicia only and does not govern this título.
entry_requirements: NOT FOUND — the conservatory's own programme page was not reached before the search budget was exhausted.
complementary_credits_required: RUCT: not applicable — Enseñanzas Artísticas register, absent from RUCT by design (confirmed: zero conservatory rows in output/ruct-backbone.jsonl and output/ruct-detail.jsonl). Admission document (for the applicant): NO complementos de formación are imposed, and the degree bar is explicitly open, quoted verbatim — "Para acceder a las enseñanzas oficiales de Máster será necesario estar en posesión de un Título Superior oficial de Enseñanzas Artísticas, de un título oficial de Graduado o Graduada o su equivalente expedido por una institución del Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior... Asimismo, podrán acceder los titulados conforme a sistemas educativos ajenos al Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior sin necesidad de la homologación de sus títulos, previa comprobación por la Administración educativa competente de que aquellos acreditan un nivel de formación equivalente." ⚠ This is the single most useful finding in this batch for a non-EEES candidate: a Tunisian degree can access WITHOUT homologación, subject to an equivalence check by the education administration. Two hard language gates instead: "Será imprescindible acreditar un nivel mínimo de inglés correspondiente al Intermedio (B1) MCER o equivalente", and "Los estudiantes extranjeros cuya lengua materna no sea el español deberán acreditar documentalmente un nivel mínimo de español Intermedio (B1) MCER o equivalente". Prueba de acceso by itinerario: Creación = "Presentación y defensa de un portafolio personal (máximo de 20 minutos) con una selección escogida libremente de composiciones -sean publicadas o inéditas- y/o proyectos artístico-culturales (50%)" plus expediente 20%, currículum 15%, entrevista 15%; Investigación = portfolio of articles/papers OR audio-video recordings plus defence of a freely chosen research topic (50%) plus the same 20/15/15; Interpretación = 40-minute public audition (or a single-take unedited video) at 50%. Separately the centre publishes a formal "Transferencia y reconocimiento de créditos" regime under RD 1614/2009 art. 6.1, Decreto 163/2015 art. 10 and the Orde do 21 de novembro de 2016 (DOG 1/12/2016) — relevant to the 300-ECTS advanced-standing question, though it recognises content correlation, not surplus credits per se.
application_window_2027: NOT YET PUBLISHED for curso 2027-28 (a September 2027 start) as of 2026-08-25. Published window for CURSO 2026-27, verbatim from the centre's "Calendario de acceso ao Máster ... CURSO 2026-27": matrícula nas probas de acceso "DO 12 AO 19 DE XUÑO" (2026), matrícula extraordinaria na proba de acceso "Ata o 23 de xuño de 2026", listas provisionais de admitidos 25 de xuño de 2026 (13:00), reclamacións 25-26 de xuño, listas definitivas 26 de xuño de 2026 (16:00), "Realización de las pruebas de acceso: Do 1 ao 2 de xullo de 2026", cualificacións 3 de xullo de 2026 (13:00), reclamacións 6-7 de xullo, lista definitiva de aspirantes que superaron a proba 8 de xullo de 2026 (13:00), "Matrícula no Máster: Del 9 al 16 de xullo de 2026". A September extraordinary convocatoria also exists — its last published concrete dates are for curso 2025-26 ("Inscrición para o acceso de setembro: Do 21 ao 24 de xullo de 2025", probas 2-3 de setembro de 2025). Dates NOT shifted forward; by pattern the 2027-28 equivalent would fall June-July 2027.
